programme.title: Journal loop / Journaallus
programme.desc: Continuous loop repetitions until the next morning. / Doorlopende herhalingen in lusvorm tot de volgende ochtend.

programme.title: In bed met Olly / In bed met Olly
programme.desc: A famous guest spends the night with Olly Wannabe for ten weeks. But there is little sleep in the house... / Tien weken lang blijft een bekende gast slapen bij Olly Wannabe. Maar van slapen komt weinig in huis ...

programme.title: Ninja Express / Ninja Express
programme.desc: Aka, Kiro and Konpeki are three ninjas with fabulous superpowers. With their special parcel service they can deliver absolutely anything at any time and to any conceivable location. / Aka, Kiro en Konpeki zijn drie ninjas met fabelachtige superkrachten. Met hun bijzondere pakketdienst kunnen ze werkelijk alles op elk ogenblik en op elke voorstelbare locatie afleveren.

programme.title: Lou / Lou
programme.desc: Animated series about the daily life of the 12-year-old girl Lou and her friends who are on the threshold of adolescence. Based on the comic series of the same name by Julien Neel. / Animatiereeks over het dagelijkse leven van het 12-jarige meisje Lou en haar vrienden die op de drempel van de adolescentie staan. Gebaseerd op de gelijknamige stripreeks van Julien Neel.

programme.title: Dodo / Dodo
programme.desc: Comic animated series about the daily experiences of 11-year-old student Joe Connolly. / Komische animatieserie over de dagelijkse belevenissen van de 11-jarige scholier Joe Connolly.

programme.title: De Faker / De Faker
programme.desc: At first glance it seems like an ordinary family, but something is not right. One of the family members has been replaced by an actor. But who is that? / Op het oog lijkt het een doodgewoon gezin maar er klopt iets niet. Een van de gezinsleden is vervangen door een acteur. Maar wie dat is?

programme.title: The week of Karrewiet with VGT / De week van Karrewiet met VGT
programme.desc: The news of the past week provided with Flemish Sign Language. / Het nieuws van de afgelopen week voorzien van Vlaamse Gebarentaal.

programme.title: Hello Kroket / Hallo Kroket
programme.desc: Daily live show in which the KETNET wrappers draw you into the world of KETNET and that of the Ketnetters. Expect famous guests, crazy scoops, fun performances, exciting games and so much more. HELLO CROQUETTE! / Dagelijkse liveshow waarin de KETNET-wrappers je meetrekken in de wereld van KETNET en die van de Ketnetters. Verwacht je aan bekende gasten, zotte primeurs, leuke optredens, spannende spelletjes en nog zo veel meer. HALLO KROKET!

programme.title: #IkLome / #LikeMe
programme.desc: Caro and Maria notice that there is something wrong with their BFF Yemi. After all, he behaves noticeably differently. They want to know what's going on, but the boy swears that everything is fine. Meanwhile, Emma and Caro seem to be growing closer. / Caro en Maria merken dat er iets is met hun BFF Yemi. Hij gedraagt zich immers opvallend anders. Ze willen weten wat er speelt, maar de jongen zweert dat alles prima is. Ondertussen lijken Emma en Caro meer naar elkaar toe te groeien.

programme.title: Girls / Meisjes
programme.desc: Compilation of the video fragments from the web series Girls that were shown this week on Ketnet's online platforms. The series is based on the Norwegian web-only drama series Jenter. / Compilatie van de videofragmenten van de webreeks Meisjes die deze week op de online platformen van Ketnet te zien waren. De reeks is gebaseerd op de Noorse web only dramareeks Jenter.

programme.title: Prank Squad / Prank Squad
programme.desc: Nona and Jean-Romy are targeting Imea from the Ketnetband. During a performance, Gio and a living plant scare her. / Nona en Jean-Romy richten hun pijlen op Imea van de Ketnetband. Bij een optreden doen Gio en een levende plant haar verschieten.

programme.title: De Board of Soekie / De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: Because he tells juicy gossip, Rudyard finally gets attention from the girl he has had a crush on for years. She wants more gossip from him. Rudyard doesn't want to lose her attention and starts coming up with spectacular gossip. He did not think that his gossip would reach such proportions that even his best friend Soekie had to resign as chairman. / Omdat hij sappige roddels vertelt, krijgt Rudyard eindelijk aandacht van het meisje waar hij al jarenlang een crush op heeft. Ze wil meer roddels van hem. Rudyard wil haar aandacht niet verliezen en begint spectaculaire roddels te verzinnen. Hij had niet gedacht dat zijn roddels zon grote proporties zouden aannemen waardoor zelfs zijn beste vriendin Soekie moet aftreden als voorzitter.

programme.title: The Hoppers / De Hoppers
programme.desc: Daria always comes second, after Olivia, in the physics exam. This year Daria wants to change that. She makes a tight exam schedule that only causes her more stress. Arno has his own exam schedule, which consists of relaxing and chilling. / Daria is altijd tweede, na Olivia, op het examen fysica. Dit jaar wil Daria er verandering in brengen. Ze maakt een strakke examenplanning die haar enkel meer stress oplevert. Arno heeft zijn eigen examenplanning, die bestaat uit relaxen en chillen.

programme.title: WinWin / WinWin
programme.desc: Consumer tips that help you make life better and affordable. Hakim Chatar cooks with the leftovers from the previous episodes. Annabet Ampofo presents the Consumer Cup, this time in Buggenhout. In Customer Service we are sent from pillar to post at RyanAir. And our insurance expert Barbara van Speybroeck answers the question whether you are also insured for burglary if you have left your window open yourself. / Consumententips die je helpen om het leven beter en betaalbaar te maken. Hakim Chatar kookt met de restjes uit de vorige afleveringen. Annabet Ampofo reikt de Consumenten Cup uit, deze keer in Buggenhout. In de Klantendienst worden we van het kastje naar de muur gestuurd bij RyanAir. En onze verzekeringsexpert Barbara van Speybroeck beantwoordt de vraag of je ook verzekerd bent voor inbraak, als je zelf je raam hebt laten openstaan.

programme.title: At home / Thuis
programme.desc: Dries loses his self-control. Femke and Peter have a good conversation. Joren and Ilias surprise their sweethearts. Angèle makes it cozy in Bar Madam; maybe a little too cozy?! Nora plucks up her courage and speaks to Waldek about the proposal she has received. / Dries verliest zijn zelfbeheersing. Femke en Peter hebben een goed gesprek. Joren en Ilias verrassen hun liefjes. Angèle maakt het gezellig in Bar Madam; misschien wel iets te gezellig?! Nora grijpt haar moed bij elkaar en spreekt Waldek aan over het voorstel dat ze heeft gekregen.

programme.title: Cops Maastricht / Flikken Maastricht
programme.desc: A Bulgarian Roma girl is found murdered. It turns out she gave birth just before her death. Eva and Wolfs, who is back at work, receive help from Interpol, a Bulgarian detective. But it turns out that he has his own agenda. Romeo and Marion deal with a strangely helpful stalker. / Een Bulgaars Roma meisje wordt vermoord aangetroffen. Ze blijkt net voor haar dood bevallen te zijn. Eva en Wolfs, die weer aan het werk is, krijgen hulp van Interpol, een Bulgaarse rechercheur. Maar die blijkt er een eigen agenda op na te houden. Romeo en Marion krijgen met een merkwaardig hulpvaardige stalker te maken.

programme.title: Traveling Waes: the bucket list / Reizen Waes: de bucketlist
programme.desc: Tom shows a completely different side of the Philippines. Far from the snow-white beaches and mass tourism on the many islands, Tom stays away from the beaten tourist path in the Philippines. Tom discovers the hard life in the metropolis of Manila, ends up at a traditional mass wedding and learns what so-called bird's nest soup is. As the icing on the cake, Tom even had his first tattoo done by a 106 (!) year old woman. / Tom laat een heel andere kant van de Filipijnen zien. Ver weg van de hagelwitte stranden en het massatoerisme op de vele eilanden, blijft Tom weg van de platgetreden toeristische paden in de Filipijnen. Zo ontdekt Tom het harde leven in de miljoenenstad Manila, belandt hij op een traditioneel massahuwelijk en leert hij wat zogenaamde vogelnestsoep is. Als kers op de taart laat Tom zelfs zn eerste tattoo zetten door een 106 (!)-jarige vrouw.

programme.title: Hotel Romance / Hotel Romantiek
programme.desc: Gloria, Sven and Philippe take the couples on a world trip today and take selfies at various monuments. / Gloria, Sven en Philippe nemen de koppels vandaag mee op wereldreis en nemen selfies aan verschillende monumenten.

programme.title: Cops / Flikken
programme.desc: Commissioner Vanbruane and Vanneste are the talking points of the commissioner's office. And things don't improve when Nadine's ex appears, reporting the disappearance of his stepdaughter. Raymond tries to put an end to an annual phenomenon: the defacement of the statue of King Baudouin in the Citadel Park... / Commissaris Vanbruane en Vanneste zijn de gespreksstof van het commissariaat. En dat betert er niet op wanneer de ex van Nadine verschijnt, die de verdwijning van zijn stiefdochter komt melden. Raymond probeert een einde te maken aan een jaarlijks weerkerend fenomeen: de besmeuring van het beeld van Koning Boudewijn in het Citadelpark...

programme.title: #IkLome / #LikeMe
programme.desc: Friendship troubles are the cause of a serious argument at school and everyone points the finger at each other for who is to blame. But it is mainly Yemi who pays the price, which makes the boy suddenly feel very lonely. / Vriendschapsperikelen liggen aan de oorsprong van een hevige ruzie op school en iedereen wijst naar elkaar voor wie er de schuld van draagt. Maar het is vooral Yemi die het gelag betaalt, waardoor de jongen zich plots heel eenzaam voelt.

programme.title: Girls / Meisjes
programme.desc: Amelie, Cleo, Fleur and Luna are best friends and together they experience all kinds of adventures. The young girls can count on each other's support at school and they also hold their own in the outside world. / Amelie, Cleo, Fleur en Luna zijn beste vriendinnen en samen beleven ze allerlei avonturen. De jonge meiden kunnen op elkaars steun rekenen op school en ook in de buitenwereld staan ze samen hun mannetje.

programme.title: Prank Squad / Prank Squad
programme.desc: With the help of Metejoor, our Prank Squad Ketnet wrapper tries to prank Thomas. A loud surprise awaits him in the Kingsize studio. / Met de hulp van Metejoor probeert onze Prank Squad Ketnet-wrapper Thomas te pranken. In de Kingsize-studio staat hem een luide verrassing op te wachten.

programme.title: Bernie / Bernie
programme.desc: Funny animated series about the genius inventor Bernie who is lost at the bottom of the ocean. With his clumsy and crazy new neighbors, a return to the island will not be easy! / Grappige animatiereeks over de geniale uitvinder Bernie die verdwaald is op de bodem van de oceaan. Met zijn onhandige en maffe nieuwe buren wordt een terugkeer naar het eiland alvast niet makkelijk!

programme.title: De Board of Soekie / De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: Pedro wants to turn BROL into an elite school. That is good for his image. To achieve this, he decides that only the 1% smartest children will receive lessons. The 99% of other students no longer receive lessons. They are allowed to color and play games in the basement. This makes them dumber and the 1% smart children become smarter. Soekie rebels because everyone has the right to education. But she finds no support from her fellow students. They are happy that they don't have to take lessons. / Pedro wil van het BROL een eliteschool maken. Dat is goed voor zijn imago. Om dat te bereiken, beslist hij dat enkel de 1% slimste kinderen nog les krijgen. De 99% andere leerlingen krijgen geen les meer. Ze mogen in de kelder kleuren en spelletjes spelen. Ze worden daardoor dommer en de 1% slimme kinderen worden slimmer. Soekie komt in opstand omdat iedereen recht heeft op onderwijs. Maar ze vindt geen steun bij de medeleerlingen. Die zijn blij dat ze geen les moeten volgen.

programme.title: The Hoppers / De Hoppers
programme.desc: The lightning cuts out the electricity and Wi-Fi. Geert forces the family to play board games. Maar de spelletjes Twister en Monopoly lopen uit de hand.

programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. How does our native lump breathe and does she have a flat in her beauty? What do they remember? What are they stunned before? What are they coming back? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell the story, who we do not know how much they carry love, research, courage in themselves, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt the suffering and beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

programme.title: Persona / Persona
programme.desc: The Person series is a Turkish criminal drama from 2018. in the director of the Sayplace, which in magnificent way connects the true tragedy and absurdity of life, and the test of existence puts moral values. The story is followed by a retired Judge and the widower Aga, which was diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. Aware that will soon forget everything, that from his personality and value will not remain nothing, he makes a fatal decision - he will kill all the criminals who skillfully dragged himself under the hands of the law. He goes into a vengeful campaign, and the task of revealing who turns the dirtiest souls and minds of Istanbul the inspection nevers, which has been a jailer in their own living. Will Aga and Nerva be opponents or will join their strengths? How terrible will be the network of secrets, death of witnesses and forgets? / Serija Persona je turska kriminalistička drama iz 2018. godine u režiji Onura Sajlaka, koja na veličanstven način spaja istinsku tragediju i apsurd života, a na test postojanja stavlja moralne vrijednosti. Priča prati penzionisanog sudiju i udovca Agu, kojem je dijagnostifikovana Alchajmerova bolest. Svjestan da će uskoro zaboraviti sve, da od njegove ličnosti i vrijednosti neće ostati ništa, donosi kobnu odluku – ubiće sve zločince koji su se vješto izvukli ispod ruke zakona. On polazi u osvetnički pohod, a zadatak da otkrije ko redom uvija najprljavije duše i umove Istambula pripašće inspektorki Nevri, koja je već godinama tamničar sopstvenih životnih bura. Da li će Aga i Nerva biti protivnici ili će udružiti svoje snage? Koliko će strašna biti mreža tajni, smrtim svjedoka i zaborava?

programme.title: From morning to tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. The two of them except the couple are in the studio, they are for years and private life. However, what the audience doesn't even want, is that their idyll on the screen has nothing to do with what the cameras turn off - the two of them actually live a nightmare. Damjan will have to play an Oscar brand, and will it work? programme.title: Fundus / Fundus
programme.desc: "Fundus" is a TV story format whose themes are BH. Cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of valuable cultural treasure that preserve museums across the country. The best promotion of the state is through its rich and varied culture. Museum depots keep thousands of valuable cases and exhibits, including numerous world rarities. Collections and collections do not even lag behind the settings in reputable European and world museums. This form of BHRT wants to present them to the general public and remind them of their value. The stories are processed only by basic and most interesting details, with the aim of encouraging viewers to visit museums and institutions in which exhibits are found. In the fundus you will see the interesting facts you haven't known so far, the items you haven't seen before, and it will also present part of the tradition on which there is no information recorded. / "Fundus" je format TV priča čije su teme bh. kulturno-historijsko naslijeđe, nepoznate priče i detalji iz naše baštine, ali i podsjećanje na vrijedno kulturno blago koje čuvaju muzeji širom zemlje. Najbolja promocija države je preko njene bogate i raznovrsne kulture. Muzejski depoi čuvaju hiljade vrijednih predmeta i eksponata, među kojima su brojni svjetski rariteti. Kolekcije i zbirke ni po čemu ne zaostaju za postavkama u uglednim evropskim i svjetskim muzejima. Ovom formom BHRT želi da ih predstavi široj javnosti i podsjeti na njihovu vrijednost. Priče obrađuju samo osnovne i najzanimljivije detalje, s ciljem da potaknu gledatelje da za više informacija posjete muzeje i ustanove u kojima se nalaze eksponati. U Fundusu ćete vidjeti zanimljivosti koje do sada niste znali, predmete koje niste prije vidjeli, a predstaviće i dio tradicije o kojoj nema zabilježenih informacija.

Dio sadržaja emisije su i reportaže o manje poznatim mjestima, ali i priče o lijepim i neobičnim predjelima naše zemlje, te vrijednim i zanimljivim ljudima.

programme.title: Victims of love / Žrtve ljubavi
programme.desc: Corrado feels guilty of being attacked by his wife, and organizes a great search for Sylvia. She fears the worst, afraid that Sylvia has taken her life in despair. But they eventually find her unconscious in the woods. Brando is constantly with Giosueo, who has problems with breathing. Lucrezia, who is also with him, teaches him a letter from the Sava River, then Brando becomes aware of the affection that the Countess Farnes of San Rossore expresses him. Even Jacopo Farnes, when he comes to visit to Des Alpes, realizes that his daughter has deep feelings for the young worker. Tommaso manages to visit Maddalen in prison and then discover that Silvia will not release her with charges. He goes angrily to his aunt and convinces her to withdraw her testimony. Roots: Francesca Valtort, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree NoFereini, Federica de Benedittis / Corrado se osjeća krivim što je napadao svoju ženu, i organizuje veliku potragu za Silvijom. Strahuje od najgorega, boji se da si je Silvija u očaju oduzela život. No nju na kraju nađu onesviještenu u šumi. Brando je stalno uz Giosueoa, koji ima problema s disanjem. Lucrezia, koja je također uz njega, predaje mu pismo od Saverija, tada Brando postaje svjestan naklonosti koju mu iskazuje grofica Farnesi od San Rossorea. Čak i Jacopo Farnesi, kada dođe u posjet u Des Alpes, shvati da njegova kćerka gaji duboke osjećaje prema mladom radniku. Tommaso uspije posjetiti Maddalenu u zatvoru i tada otkrije da je Silvija neće osloboditi optužbi. Gnjevno odlazi svojoj tetki i uvjeri je da povuče svoje svjedočenje. Uloge: Francesca Valtorta, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree Nofereini, Federica De Benedittis

programme.title: Tri mace / Tri mace
programme.desc: Animated series for the youngest about adventures of three fearless kittens who are always ready for new challenges. The cheerful kitten biscuit lives with his big brother Chok and little sister Lola. Their days are filled with fun and socializing with best friends. They like to play, eat sweets, and explore unknown phenomena and objects that surround them. Every day, they embark on a new adventure, and thanks to the wise advice of their caring parents, they solve all obstacles and learn numerous life lessons. / Animirana serija za najmlađe o pustolovinama tri neustrašiva mačića koji su uvijek spremni za nove izazove. Veseli mačić Keksić živi s velikim bratom Čokom i malenom sestrom Lolom. Njihovi dani ispunjeni su zabavom i druženjem s najboljim prijateljima. Vole se igrati, jesti slatkiše, te istraživati nepoznate pojave i predmete koji ih okružuju. Svaki dan upuštaju se u novu pustolovinu, a zahvaljujući mudrim savjetima njihovih brižnih roditelja, rješavaju sve prepreke i uče brojne životne lekcije.

programme.title: The game of fate / Igra sudbine
programme.desc: Nehir calls Ferida to the office and tells her to stop approaching Aziz, because she will dig a grave for herself. Feride bravely replied that she was Aziz's future. Kerem faces a bullent and tells him that he is his grandfather and the dark side of life. Perihan tells Aziza that she will never accept Feride despite his love for her. Tekin comes to Madam Anet to visit her to visit the Sultan. In the settlement Emine, Feride and Altan organized a large iftar. Aziz comes to Salih-Baba, asking him permission to propose to Feride. / Nehir poziva Feride u ured i govori joj da se prestane približavati Azizu, jer će sebi iskopati grob. Feride joj hrabro odgovori da je ona Azizova budućnost. Kerem se suočava s Bulentom i govori mu da je on njegov djed i tamna strana života. Perihan kaže Azizu da ona nikad neće prihvatiti Feride uprkos njegovoj ljubavi prema njoj. Tekin dolazi po madam Anet da je odvede u posjetu Sultan. U naselju su Emine, Feride i Altan organizovali veliki iftar. Aziz dolazi kod Salih-babe tražeći od njega dozvolu da zaprosi Feride.

programme.title: Witness to reality and fantasy / Priča o stvarnosti i fantaziji
programme.desc: The story of reality and fantasy - (Educational Program, Croatia, 2024) In the history of Croatian Radio and Television, some people have given their face to a small screen, so we all remember them. And some, behind the camera, created our cultural heritage as authors. We usually don't know much about them. When a man gets off the stage of his life, his story disappears into oblivion. They say some stories existed to be forgotten. Thanks to the fragments of the memory of colleagues and friends, preserved recordings and fragments of literary creativity, this one, at least for now, is not. More than four hundred works of all television formats and genres were preserved in the HRT archives, signed by director Drazen Piskoric. This is the story of the "reality and fantasy" of his life. R .: Ljiljana Šišmanović ... / Priča o stvarnosti i fantaziji - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2024) U povijesti Hrvatske radiotelevizije neki ljudi su dali svoje lice malom ekranu, pa ih svi pamtimo. A neki su, iza kamere, kao autori stvarali našu kulturnu baštinu. O njima, obično, ne znamo mnogo. Kad čovjek siđe s pozornice svoga života, njegova priča nestaje u zaboravu. Kažu kako su neke priče postojale da bi bile zaboravljene. Zahvaljujući fragmentima sjećanja kolega i prijatelja, sačuvanim snimkama i ulomcima literarnog stvaralaštva, ova, barem zasad, nije. U arhivu HRT-a sačuvano je više od četiri stotine djela svih televizijskih formata i žanrova koje potpisuje redatelj Dražen Piškorić. Ovo je priča o "stvarnosti i fantaziji" njegova života. R.: Ljiljana Šišmanović...

programme.title: Third age / Treća dob
programme.desc: Third age - (educational program, Croatia) long -awaited amount of annual pension supplement, colloquially called the thirteenth pension, was welcomed as a cold shower for many pensioners - on October 1st, October 1st. The amount of 6 euros per year is considered as shameful, and the abolition of pension taxes - by favoring those with the highest income. On the other hand, the Government and coalition partner of the Croatian pensioner party point out that this contributes to the improvement of the position of the elderly fellow citizens. But most of them barely survive, pensioners are testified daily. Unfortunately, there are a small number of those whose pensions exceed the average and who will feel an increase after applying a new tax policy. More than 60 percent of a total of one million and two hundred thousand retirees receive pensions lower than the average, which officially amounts to 690 euros. All this - and the way that came to the amount of 6 euros per year - on the third age program on Monday, the President of the Croatian Retirement Union, Višnja Stanisic, will be given by the clarification of State Secretary Marinko Luikned ... / Treća dob - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) Dugoočekivani iznos godišnjeg dodatka na mirovinu, kolokvijalno nazvan trinaesta mirovina, dočekan je kao hladan tuš za mnoge umirovljenike - upravo na Međunarodni dan starijih osoba, 1. listopada. Iznos od 6 eura po godini staža mnogi smatraju sramotnim, a ukidanje poreza na mirovine - pogodovanjem onima s najvišim primanjima. S druge strane, Vlada i koalicijski partner Hrvatska stranka umirovljenika ističu da se time doprinosi unaprjeđenju položaja starijih sugrađana. No, da većina jedva preživljava, svakodnevno svjedoče upravo umirovljenici. Nažalost, malen je broj onih čije mirovine prelaze prosjek i koji će osjetiti povećanje nakon primjene nove porezne politike. Više od 60 posto od ukupno milijun i dvjesto tisuća umirovljenika prima mirovine niže od prosjeka, koji službeno iznosi 690 eura. O svemu tome - i o načinu na koji se došlo do iznosa od 6 eura po godini staža - u emisiji Treća dob u ponedjeljak na govorit će predsjednica Sindikata umirovljenika Hrvatske Višnja Stanišić, a pojašnjenje će dati i državni tajnik Marinko Luikneda...

Desert će biti kolačići s ricottom i komadićima čokolade, omiljeni u Lidijinoj obitelji. Pridružite se Lidiji i naučite koliko je ricotta svestrana. Koliko ih učimo prometnim pravilima, koliko smo mi odrasli odgovorni, što možemo učiniti da im put bude siguran?...

programme.title: Cocoa / Cacau
programme.desc: Cacao - (S02, E12, feature series, Portugal, 2024) telenovela talks about the life of a beautiful, brave and unrestrained 22 -year -old girl Cacau who lives on a property with her parents Portuguese, Joaquim and Filomena. They are hosts and people of the trust of the rich boss of Justin, a vase of Pereire, also a Portuguese, who is old and ill, and follows the business from Portugal. The best friends of Cacau are Pitty and Guto who help her make the idea that Brazil tasted the best chocolate - spicy chocolate from Itacare. Cacau works at the chocolate factory, and spends his free time in the warm sea of ​​Bahia where he loves surf. She is gifted with chocolate manufacturer, and her biggest dream is to get an international degree in confectionery and chocolate skills. However, she believes that this is unattainable because her family does not need money for that very expensive course. R.: Ricardo Carreira Ul.: Matilde Reymao (Cacau), Jose Condessa (Tiago), Alexandra Lencastre (Simone de Gusmao), Paulo Pires (Salomao), Ines Castel-Branco (Lala) ... / Cacao - (S02, E12, igrana serija, Portugal, 2024) Telenovela govori o životu lijepe, hrabre i neobuzdane 22-godišnje djevojke Cacau koja živi na imanju na kojemu su njezini roditelji Portugalci, Joaquim i Filomena. Oni su domaćini i ljudi od povjerenja bogatoga gazde Justina Vaza Pereire, također Portugalca, koji je star i bolestan, pa prati poslovanje iz Portugala. Najbolji prijatelji Cacau su Pitty i Guto koji joj pomažu ostvariti zamisao da Brazil kuša najbolju čokoladu - pikantnu čokoladu iz Itacarea. Cacau radi u tvornici čokolade, a slobodno vrijeme provodi u toplom moru Bahije gdje voli surfati. Nadarena je proizvođačica čokolade, a najveći joj je san dobiti međunarodnu diplomu iz slastičarstva i čokoladnih vještina. Ipak vjeruje da joj je to nedostižno jer njezina obitelj nema potreban novac za taj vrlo skup tečaj. R.: Ricardo Carreira Ul.: Matilde Reymao (Cacau), Jose Condessa (Tiago), Alexandra Lencastre (Simone de Gusmao), Paulo Pires (Salomao), Ines Castel-Branco (Lala)...

programme.title: The Promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E44, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Provece owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E44, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. programme.title: Herbs / Lovac na bilje
programme.desc: Plague hunter - (S03, E03, Doc. Series, Croatia, 2021) Plagen hunter visits the "Croatian Sahara", which is made up of the remains of the only Croatian desert and the geographical -Botanical reserve. The desert is located on the eastern part of the town of Đurđevac. Đurđevac Sands represent a variety of habitats for the entire living settlement. Some of the plants in this episode are gray thunder, silk, chin chin, early hamster, rabbit and medicinal asparagus. The guests of the episode are B.Sc. Geology Martin Mahović and Željka Kolar from the Public Institution for Management of Protected Nature Parts in the Koprivnica-Križevci County. R.: Filip Filkovic ... / Lovac na bilje - (S03, E03, dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2021) Lovac na bilje posjećuje "Hrvatsku Saharu" koju čine ostaci jedine hrvatske pustinje i geografsko-botanički rezervat. Neke od biljaka u ovoj epizodi su siva gromotulja, svilenica, vlasulja bradica, rani hrčak, zečjak i ljekovita šparoga. Gosti epizode su dipl. ing. geologije Martin Mahović i Željka Kolar iz Javne ustanove za upravljanje zaštićenim dijelovima prirode na području Koprivničko-križevačke županije. R.: Filip Filković...

programme.title: Witness to reality and fantasy / Priča o stvarnosti i fantaziji
programme.desc: The story of reality and fantasy - (Educational Program, Croatia, 2024) In the history of Croatian Radio and Television, some people have given their face to a small screen, so we all remember them. And some, behind the camera, created our cultural heritage as authors. We usually don't know much about them. When a man gets off the stage of his life, his story disappears into oblivion. They say some stories existed to be forgotten. Thanks to the fragments of the memory of colleagues and friends, preserved recordings and fragments of literary creativity, this one, at least for now, is not. More than four hundred works of all television formats and genres were preserved in the HRT archives, signed by director Drazen Piskoric. This is the story of the "reality and fantasy" of his life. R .: Ljiljana Šišmanović ... / Priča o stvarnosti i fantaziji - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2024) U povijesti Hrvatske radiotelevizije neki ljudi su dali svoje lice malom ekranu, pa ih svi pamtimo. A neki su, iza kamere, kao autori stvarali našu kulturnu baštinu. O njima, obično, ne znamo mnogo. Kad čovjek siđe s pozornice svoga života, njegova priča nestaje u zaboravu. Kažu kako su neke priče postojale da bi bile zaboravljene. Zahvaljujući fragmentima sjećanja kolega i prijatelja, sačuvanim snimkama i ulomcima literarnog stvaralaštva, ova, barem zasad, nije. U arhivu HRT-a sačuvano je više od četiri stotine djela svih televizijskih formata i žanrova koje potpisuje redatelj Dražen Piškorić. Ovo je priča o "stvarnosti i fantaziji" njegova života. The psychic crisis and personal tragedy forced him to reconsider his life and move out of Britain. Ben will find out that Alex once survived without heating, electricity and water. Today, it remodges centuries -old buildings into an ideal farmhouse. She will tell Ben what challenges face by living in the hottest part of Portugal, and that, although he enjoys a solitary life, he is ready to hang out with like -minded people again. Among the like -minded people is a friend who helps him accomplish the plan to open the farm for guests. And she has an exceptional life story. programme.title: Maze / Labirint
programme.desc: Labyrinth - (Talk Show, Croatia) In the heart of post -war Yugoslavia, Industrogradnja, a company that changed cities and lives, was born. Skyscrapers, hotels, monumental bridges, residential buildings - she was building it all. And it was built in Germany, Poland, Iraq, Russia ... Moscow adorns the impressive Russian Academy of Sciences, which is their hands. In the show "Legend of Industrogradnja" we discover stories behind concrete and steel, we explore who created and who destroyed Industrogradnja. How did the construction giant who once counted 12,500 employees disappeared? ... / Labirint - (talk show, Hrvatska) U srcu poslijeratne Jugoslavije rodila se Industrogradnja, firma koja je mijenjala gradove i živote. Neboderi, hoteli, monumentalni mostovi, stambeni objekti - sve je to ona gradila. A gradilo se u Njemačkoj, Poljskoj, Iraku, Rusiji... Moskvu krasi impresivna Ruska akademija znanosti koja je njihovih ruku djelo. U emisiji "Legenda o Industrogradnji" otkrivamo priče iza betona i čelika, istražujemo tko je stvarao, a tko rušio Industrogradnju. Kako je nestao građevinski div koji je nekad brojao 12.500 zaposlenih?...

programme.title: Parenting in the animal world / Roditeljstvo u životinjskom svijetu
programme.desc: Parenthood - (E03, Nature. Film, England, 2025) On the open lawns of our planet, parents must constantly weigh between risk and gain when raising the next generation. Although abundant grass promises an abundance of food and places where the family can settle, open regions mean competition and predators. In England, the imaginative potter is exploiting all the grace of the lawn. Skillfully builds a clay cradle and is full to the top of the offspring for offspring they will never meet. In the Keni Park, Masai Mara Geprodica on the outdoor expanses of the cubs shows the hunting skills they will need when they grow up. It will be crucial when she needs help with the gnu cub. It is more difficult for others to achieve. On the open plains of Donji Zambezi, everything is on the side of the thirty -member pack of wild dogs. But parents have to instill a sense of discipline into their inexperienced cubs or hunting can perish. In India, Mother Langu, they must learn to be good nanny before they take on the role of parents - and to some it doesn't fall easy! It is a world where the balance between risk and gain is constantly changing: parents everywhere in Ravnice are forced to new and difficult decisions. In the Kalahari nests of brownish sparrows, the largest in the world, usually protecting the colony from the sun's heat. But unbearable thermal wave causes the breakdown of social order as dissatisfied neighbors begin to throw birds out of the nest. In Patagonia, the mother of Gvanak must join thousands of others in an attempt to arrive at winter feding sites for the survival of their descendants, in which they are disturbed by kilometers and kilometers of fences. Adversity and parents are increasingly difficult for animal parents, but people can provide simple solutions. R .: Elisabeth Oakham Ul.: Sir David Attenborough (Narrator) ... / Parenthood - (E03, prirod. film, Engleska, 2025) Na otvorenim travnjacima našeg planeta roditelji moraju pri podizanju sljedećeg naraštaja stalno vagati između rizika i dobitka. Iako obilna trava obećava obilje hrane i mjesta na kojima se obitelj može nastaniti, otvoreni predjeli znače konkurenciju i grabežljivce. U Engleskoj domišljata lončarska osa iskorištava svu blagodat travnjaka. Vješto gradi glinenu kolijevku i puni je do vrha gusjenicama za potomstvo koje nikad neće upoznati. U kenijskom parku Masai Mara gepardica na otvorenom prostranstvu mladuncima pokazuje lovačke vještine koje će im trebati kad odrastu. Bit će to presudno kad joj zatreba pomoć u obaranju mladunca gnua. Drugima je ravnotežu teže postići. Na otvorenim ravnicama donjeg Zambezija, sve je na strani trideseteročlanog čopora divljih pasa. Ali roditelji moraju u svoje neiskusne mladunce usaditi osjećaj discipline ili im lov može propasti. U Indiji majke langura moraju naučiti biti dobre dadilje prije nego što preuzmu ulogu roditelja - a nekima to ne pada lako! To je svijet u kojem se ravnoteža između rizika i dobitka stalno mijenja: roditelji svugdje u ravnicama prisiljeni su na nove i teške odluke. U Kalahariju gnijezda smeđokapih vrabaca, najveća na svijetu, obično štite koloniju od sunčeve topline. No nepodnošljivi toplinski val uzrokuje raspad društvenog poretka jer nezadovoljni susjedi počinju izbacivati ptiće iz gnijezda. U Patagoniji majka gvanaka mora se pridružiti tisućama drugih u pokušaju da stigne na zimska hranilišta radi opstanka njihovih potomaka, u čemu ih ometaju kilometri i kilometri ograde. Nedaće i roditelje životinjskim je roditeljima sve teže zaobići, ali ljudi mogu pružiti jednostavna rješenja. R.: Elisabeth Oakham Ul.: Sir David Attenborough (Narrator)...

programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E44, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Provece owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Dance of destiny / Ples sudbine
programme.desc: Alem that illuminated - (E16, telenovela, Brazil, 2022) The sugar reed mill was flooded. The village was destroyed and many residents lost almost everything and became homeless. Olívia begs Rafael for help to improve working conditions and take Joaquim's salary with a brilliant move to help workers and factory. Zato su se gotovo svi razboljeli. Isadora provodi noć u nastambi za robove sa svim radnicima koji pomažu oko svega i oko Rafaela. Joaquim se sukobi s majstorom, Eugeniom i Violetom zbog krađe novca iz tvornice. Ali bježi zbog Úrsule. Olívia moli Rafaela za pomoć kako bi poboljšala radne uvjete i briljantnim potezom uzima Joaquimovu plaću da pomogne radnicima i tvornici. Heloísa vidi kako Matias pregledava kćerine stvari i poludi. Rafael izjavi ljubav Isadori i poljubi je. Heloísa ponudi utočište Clarinhi dok Inácio radi u kasinu. programme.title: Third age / Treća dob
programme.desc: Third age - (educational program, Croatia) long -awaited amount of annual pension supplement, colloquially called the thirteenth pension, was welcomed as a cold shower for many pensioners - on October 1st, October 1st. The amount of 6 euros per year is considered as shameful, and the abolition of pension taxes - by favoring those with the highest income. On the other hand, the Government and coalition partner of the Croatian pensioner party point out that this contributes to the improvement of the position of the elderly fellow citizens. But most of them barely survive, pensioners are testified daily. Unfortunately, there are a small number of those whose pensions exceed the average and who will feel an increase after applying a new tax policy. More than 60 percent of a total of one million and two hundred thousand retirees receive pensions lower than the average, which officially amounts to 690 euros. All this - and the way that came to the amount of 6 euros per year - on the third age program on Monday, the President of the Croatian Retirement Union, Višnja Stanisic, will be given by the clarification of State Secretary Marinko Luikned ... / Treća dob - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) Dugoočekivani iznos godišnjeg dodatka na mirovinu, kolokvijalno nazvan trinaesta mirovina, dočekan je kao hladan tuš za mnoge umirovljenike - upravo na Međunarodni dan starijih osoba, 1. listopada. Iznos od 6 eura po godini staža mnogi smatraju sramotnim, a ukidanje poreza na mirovine - pogodovanjem onima s najvišim primanjima. S druge strane, Vlada i koalicijski partner Hrvatska stranka umirovljenika ističu da se time doprinosi unaprjeđenju položaja starijih sugrađana. No, da većina jedva preživljava, svakodnevno svjedoče upravo umirovljenici. Nažalost, malen je broj onih čije mirovine prelaze prosjek i koji će osjetiti povećanje nakon primjene nove porezne politike. Više od 60 posto od ukupno milijun i dvjesto tisuća umirovljenika prima mirovine niže od prosjeka, koji službeno iznosi 690 eura. O svemu tome - i o načinu na koji se došlo do iznosa od 6 eura po godini staža - u emisiji Treća dob u ponedjeljak na govorit će predsjednica Sindikata umirovljenika Hrvatske Višnja Stanišić, a pojašnjenje će dati i državni tajnik Marinko Luikneda...

programme.title: The Promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E45, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Provece owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E45, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

They turned a piece of land into their corner of paradise, built a house and deeply connected with the nature that surrounds them. programme.desc: Kotlina - (S01, E01, feature series, Bosnia and Herzegovina, 2022) "Kotlina" is a Bosnian criminal drama in five sequels. The series brings a dark and tense insight into the modern Sarajevo, where an investigation of a crime reveals layers of social tensions, personal dilemmas and hidden truths. Chief Inspector Edib Pasic and journalist Ajla Pasic soon realize that the search for the truth introduces them to the world of decisions that are difficult to justify but easily understand. ---- There was a body of an unknown man in the Botanical Garden of the National Museum of BiH. The investigation runs Senior Inspector Edib Pasic and his partner Mido Zec, while journalist Ajla Pasic accidentally becomes a witness to the beginning of the investigation. It is still not clear whether it is an accident or murder. At the same time, Sarajevo faces the return of Senci, who, after a long prison sentence, reveals that the city is no longer the same. R .: Danis Tanovic Ul.: Feđa Stukan (Edib), Boris Ler (Mido), Ida Keskic (Ajla), Vedrana Bozinovic (Selma), Mario Knezovic (Senci) ... / Kotlina - (S01, E01, igrana serija, Bosna i Hercegovina, 2022) "Kotlina" je bosanskohercegovačka kriminalistička drama u pet nastavaka. Glavni inspektor Edib Pašić i novinarka Ajla Pašić ubrzo shvaćaju da ih potraga za istinom uvodi u svijet odluka koje je teško opravdati, ali lako razumjeti. ---- U botaničkom vrtu Zemaljskog muzeja BiH pronađeno je tijelo nepoznatog muškarca. programme.title: Talk for a reason / Razgovor s razlogom
programme.desc: Talking for a reason - (artistic program, Croatia, 2025) The guest of the show Talking for a reason is longtime correspondent Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung for Southeast Europe - German journalist and writer Michael Martens. We talk to him about why he is so captivated by the past and the way we handle it. How much was his interest in the fact that his grandfather was a Wehrmacht officer? Why is it difficult for us to put historical events in a realistic context? How did he come up with the idea to write a book about the breakup of the former Yugoslavia - and is the correct claim that Germany was to blame for the process? What were the relations of German Chancellor Helmut Kohl and Croatian President Franjo Tudjman? What do the documents he explored about the relationship between Croatian politics to BiH at the time are revealed? From family history, through the breakup of Yugoslavia, to current events in Croatia and Europe - there are many reasons to talk to Michael Martens. R.: Sinisa Hajduk ... / Razgovor s razlogom - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2025) Gost emisije Razgovor s razlogom je dugogodišnji dopisnik Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitunga za jugoistočnu Europu - njemački novinar i pisac Michael Martens. S njim razgovaramo o tome zašto ga toliko zaokuplja prošlost i način na koji se s njom nosimo. Koliko je na njegov interes utjecala činjenica da mu je djed bio časnik Wehrmachta? Zašto nam je teško povijesne događaje staviti u realni kontekst? Kako je došao na ideju napisati knjigu o raspadu bivše Jugoslavije - i je li točna tvrdnja da je za taj proces bila kriva Njemačka? Kakvi su bili odnosi njemačkog kancelara Helmuta Kohla i hrvatskog predsjednika Franje Tuđmana? Što otkrivaju dokumenti koje je istraživao o odnosu tadašnje hrvatske politike prema BiH? Od obiteljske povijesti, preko raspada Jugoslavije, do aktualnih zbivanja u Hrvatskoj i Europi - mnogo je razloga za razgovor s Michaelom Martensom. R.: Siniša Hajduk...

programme.desc: The Goldbergs-(S09, E11, Comedy, USA, 2022) Once not so long ago and not so far, 11-year-old Adam Goldberg (Sean Giambrone) with a video camera documents life on the outskirts of the 1980s. She has full hands of work, starting with Mom Beverly (Wendi McLendon-Covey), who is well-meaning but choke him, through the temperamental dad Murray (Jeff Garlin), to the rebellious older sister Erica (Hayley Orranti) and the hypersensible brother Barry (Troy Gentile). And there is also a reasons grandfather (George Segal), a seducer, who is Adam's mentor when it comes to more beautiful things in life. Driving watches, first jobs, applications for college and acquiring new friends without losing their old ones, it's all part of the Goldberg family. Some leave their childhood behind them in search of the first kiss, others are tormented by the upbringing of teenagers or, faced with aging, remember the youthful passions - the Goldberg family will experience all that. Both in good and evil, they are always there for each other. programme.title: Wonderful world of design: new streets / Čudesni svijet dizajna: Nove ulice
programme.desc: Grand Designs: The Stroets - (S02, E03, Educational Program, England, 2022) Thirty years architect John and office administrator Julia plan to build a fantastic house designed by John. They are tormented by evil happiness - recession, losing their jobs and surpassing offers for the parcels have stood on the path of their dream of independent construction. They finally secured a plot in the hill in Oxfordshire and more than ever wanting to build their home! Architect John designed the beautiful modernist part of the home to withdraw: it is elegant, it is a hiding place of life trials. But as soon as they start construction, their unhappy string continues. Coronavirus closure stops construction and every month spent in their expensive housed house is eroded by their limited budget and therefore threatens their plans for a leisurely pension. Pressure further harms John's health. However, with limited means, there is no choice but to run the project of this complex construction. R.: Kevin McCloud ... / Grand Designs: The Streets - (S02, E03, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2022) Trideset godina arhitekt John i uredska administratorica Julia planiraju izgraditi fantastičnu kuću koju je dizajnirao John. Muči ih zla sreća - recesija, gubitak posla i nadmašivanje ponuda za parcele stali su na put njihovu snu o samostalnoj gradnji. Napokon su osigurali parcelu u Graven Hillu u Oxfordshireu i više nego ikad žele izgraditi svoj dom! Arhitekt John dizajnirao je prekrasan modernistički dio doma u koji će se povući: elegantno je to skrovište od životnih kušnji. No čim počnu s gradnjom, njihov nesretni niz se nastavlja. Zatvaranje zbog koronavirusa zaustavlja gradnju i svaki mjesec proveden u njihovoj skupoj unajmljenoj kući nagriza njihov ograničeni budžet te stoga ugrožava njihove planove za lagodnu mirovinu. Pritisak dodatno šteti Johnovu zdravlju. Ipak, s ograničenim sredstvima, nema drugog izbora nego sam voditi projekt ove kompleksne gradnje. R.: Kevin McCloud...

programme.title: Patina Mexican dishes / Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: Patis Mexican Table - (S12, E06, Educational Program, USA, 2023) Head of Passes Jinich again goes to the Mexican federal state of Yucatán, once the center of civilization of Maya, and explores the influence of this ancient people on its cultural and culinary heritage. He suffers returns to Southeast Mexico to get to know the widely known Yucatán state. The remains of the Mayan culture are still ubiquitous in everyday life, so it suffers to travel to the state to meet chefs, craftsmen and families who keep and continue that tradition. In the lively capital of Merida, it reveals that over the centuries, the Mayan cuisine has changed under the Spanish influence and became one of the best kitchens of the world ... / Patis Mexican Table - (S12, E06, obrazovni program, SAD, 2023) Voditeljica Pati Jinich ponovno odlazi u meksičku saveznu državu Yucatán, nekoć središte civilizacije Maja, te istražuje utjecaj ovog drevnog naroda na njezinu kulturnu i kulinarsku baštinu. Pati se vraća u jugoistočni Meksiko kako bi pobliže upoznala nadaleko poznatu državu Yucatán. Ostaci majanske kulture i danas su sveprisutni u svakodnevnom životu pa Pati putuje državom kako bi upoznala kuhare, obrtnike i obitelji koji čuvaju i nastavljaju tu tradiciju. U živahnom glavnom gradu Meridi otkriva kako se tijekom stoljeća majanska kuhinja mijenjala pod španjolskim utjecajem te postala jednom od najboljih kuhinja svijeta...

programme.title: Alana Titchmarsha Garden Club / Vrtlarski klub Alana Titchmarsha
programme.desc: Alan Titchmarshs Gardening Club - (S02, E16, Entertainment Program, England, 2025) Alan Titchmarsh and his team from a gardening club bring us a new season of a series full of practical tips, professional tricks and inspirational stories, celebrating the joy of gardening throughout the United Kingdom. The series brings gardens of all sizes - from urban spaces to celebrity parks - with an emphasis on sustainable and common gardening, and will give answers to the viewers' questions about everything that has to do with the garden. Alan is joined by horticulturalists Camilla Bassett-Smith and Errol Reuben Fernandes, Urban Garden Jason Williams, Claire Lowrie, Ecological Gardener Anna Greenland and Landscape Architect Henry Agg, who share their knowledge to help and maintain their own sake oases. R .: Luke Rowbotham ... / Alan Titchmarshs Gardening Club - (S02, E16, zabavni program, Engleska, 2025) Alan Titchmarsh i njegov tim iz Vrtlarskog kluba donose nam novu sezonu serije punu praktičnih savjeta, stručnih trikova i inspirativnih priča, koje slave radost vrtlarstva diljem Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva. Serija donosi vrtove svih veličina - od urbanih prostora do slavnih perivoja - s naglaskom na održivo i zajedničko vrtlarstvo, a dat će i odgovore na pitanja gledatelja o svemu što ima veze s vrtom. Alanu se pridružuju hortikulturisti Camilla Bassett-Smith i Errol Reuben Fernandes, urbani vrtlar Jason Williams, stručnjakinja za sobne biljke Claire Lowrie, ekološka vrtlarica Anna Greenland i krajobrazni arhitekt Henry Agg, koji dijele svoje znanje kako bi pomogli gledateljima uzgojiti, oblikovati i održavati vlastite zelene oaze. R.: Luke Rowbotham...

programme.title: The weekend trips with Gregg Wallace / Putovanja za vikend s Greggom Wallaceom
programme.desc: Gregg Wallaces Big Weekend Away - (S01, E05, Tourism Program, England, 2020) Gregg Wallace knows what we need for the holiday mood, the Christmas fair. Therefore, he goes to Vienna, a city where the Christmas fairs have arisen, where it will discover what it takes for the fair to be perfect and how best to enjoy them. It will get to know the world of warm drinks, special decorations, interesting traditions, winter games and many treats. It will tell us why this city, which is held today, is held more than 50 fairs, the source of numerous British Christmas traditions ... / Gregg Wallaces Big Weekend Away - (S01, E05, turistički program, Engleska, 2020) Gregg Wallace zna što nam treba za blagdansko raspoloženje, božićni sajam. Stoga odlazi u Beč, grad u kojem su božićni sajmovi nastali, gdje će otkriti što je potrebno da bi sajam bio savršen i kako najbolje uživati u njima. Upoznat će svijet toplih napitaka, posebnih ukrasa, zanimljivih tradicija, zimskih igara i mnogo poslastica. Reći će nam zašto je taj grad, u kojem se danas održava više od 50 sajmova, izvor brojnih britanskih božićnih tradicija...

programme.title: Austrian mountain villages / Austrijska gorska sela
programme.desc: Österreichs und Judgment Bergdorfer - (S02, E05, Nature. Film, Austria, 2022) in valleys such as Gastajna, Klajnarlska and Grosarla, scattered old mountain villages, rooted in local customs. The Gastajn valley has been marked by mining for centuries. The former miners nurture a special custom: dancing with swords. Willi Huttegger is certainly one of the most innovative mountain peasants. By exploiting his mountain pasture and his trade on the estate in the valley, he managed to switch to full -time agriculture. Markus Schaidreiter is still a young peasant in the Klajnarla valley who, under the motto "One for All, All for One" in cooperation with two other engaged young farmers, managed to achieve the merger of all three rural farms. The three of them want to return to the roots of agriculture. R .: Alfred Ninaus Ul.: Franz Robert Wagner (Narrator) ... / Österreichs und Sudtirols Bergdorfer - (S02, E05, prirod. film, Austrija, 2022) U dolinama kao što su Gastajnska, Klajnarlska i Grosarlska raštrkana su stara planinska sela, ukorijenjena u lokalnim običajima. Gastajnska dolina stoljećima je bila obilježena rudarstvom. Bivši rudari njeguju poseban običaj: ples s mačevima. Willi Huttegger jamačno je jedan od najinovativnijih gorskih seljaka. Iskorištavanjem svog planinskog pašnjaka i svojom trgovinom na imanju u dolini uspio se prebaciti na poljodjelstvo s punim radnim vremenom. Markus Schaidreiter još je mlad seljak u Klajnarlskoj dolini koji je pod geslom "jedan za sve, svi za jednoga" u suradnji s još dvojicom angažiranih mladih poljodjelaca uspio postići spajanje svih triju seoskih gospodarstava. Njih trojica žele se vratiti korijenima poljodjelstva. R.: Alfred Ninaus Ul.: Franz Robert Wagner (Narrator)...

programme.title: Endeavour - Young Morse / Endeavour - Mladi Morse
programme.desc: Endeavor - (S09, E01, Played Series, England, 2023) Endeavor, is re-sober, returns to the Castle Gate, just at the time of a shocking discovery in the garden of one college. The investigation takes him and Thursday to the famous Oxford Orchestra, and when a new tragedy occurs, this time among musicians, they discover the network of secrets in his heart. At the same time, bloody London problems are poured into Oxford when a cruel murder occurs in an abandoned warehouse. Solving the Endeavor and Thursday's riddle noticing the disturbing links with the case she hoped left behind them. Р.: Shaun Evans Ul.: Shaun Evans (DS Endeavor Morse), Roger Allam (DCi Fred Thursday), James Bradshaw, Sean Rigby (DS Jim Strange), Caroline Oneill (Win Thursday) ... / Endeavour - (S09, E01, igrana serija, Engleska, 2023) Endeavour se, ponovno trijezan, vraća u postaju Castle Gate baš u trenutku šokantnog otkrića u vrtu jednog koledža. Istraga vodi njega i Thursdaya do slavnog oksfordskog orkestra, a kad se dogodi nova tragedija, ovaj put među glazbenicima, oni otkriju mrežu tajni u njegovu srcu. Istodobno se krvavi londonski problemi prelijevaju u Oxford kad se dogodi okrutno ubojstvo u napuštenom skladištu. Rješavajući zagonetku Endeavour i Thursday uočavaju uznemirujuće poveznice sa slučajem za koji su se nadali da je ostao daleko iza njih. R.: Shaun Evans Ul.: Shaun Evans (DS Endeavour Morse), Roger Allam (DCI Fred Thursday), James Bradshaw (Dr. Max DeBryn), Sean Rigby (DS Jim Strange), Caroline ONeill (Win Thursday)...

programme.title: My way / Moj put
programme.desc: My path - (educational program, Croatia) is amazing how many strengths, positive energy and persistence hides in Gordana Glass, fragile and ethereal Zagreb women, since 1998. It is long and often not very comfortable to be her path to international success. From her workshop, fascinating works of art, mostly weighing and hundreds of pounds, leave for the world. Gordana is a mother of two adult sons, a woman ready to share with the needy a nice word and make her living space beautiful her work. She bent her family-commercial nest in Lamac, the suburb of Bratislava, who was inhabited by her compatriots five hundred years ago. It was one of the hundreds of the majority of Croatian villages then. Today, there are only four left: Croatian grave, Jandorf, Cunovi and Devinska Nova you. This is the latter for 36 years in memory of the centuries -old tradition and history of Croats in the area hosting the Festival of Croatian Culture. Exposed to assimilation stronger than ever before, they seek to say that they are still guarding their customs and language. Devinski's natives New Vasi still remember that Fanfare announced the first festival. It symbolically encouraged the awakening of there, the formerly forgotten, the Croatian community. It was in June 1989, on the eve of the "velvety revolution" that marked the end of the epoch of political one -sidedness. Thanks to the courage and sacrifice of many generations, the festival invokes memories of the ancient Croatian ancestor. Mostly weights, hardworking and hardworking people have inherited from the past of their specialty, the specific Chakavian-Ikav version of the Croatian Burgenland dialect, tunes, costumes, traditional dishes. R .: Silvija Trnčević ... / Moj put - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) Nevjerojatno je koliko se snage, pozitivne energije i upornosti krije u Gordani Glass, krhkoj i eteričnoj Zagrepčanki, od 1998. stanovnici glavnoga slovačkog grada Bratislave. Dug je i nerijetko ne baš lagodan bio njezin put do međunarodnog uspjeha. Iz njezine radionice u svijet odlaze fascinantna umjetnička djela mahom teška i stotine kilograma. Gordana je majka dvojici odraslih sinova, žena spremna podijeliti s potrebitima lijepu riječ i svojim radovima uljepšati im životni prostor. Svoje obiteljsko-poslovno gnijezdo savila je u Lamaču, predgrađu Bratislave, koje su prije petstotinjak godina naselili njezini sunarodnjaci. Bilo je to jedno od stotinjak tada većinskih hrvatskih sela. Danas su ostala tek četiri: Hrvatski Grob, Jandorf, Čunovo i Devinska Nova Vas. Upravo ovo potonje već 36 godina u spomen na stoljetnu tradiciju i povijest Hrvata na tom prostoru domaćin je Festivala hrvatske kulture. Izloženi asimilaciji snažnije nego ikada prije, nastoje poručiti da još čuvaju svoje običaje i jezik. Starosjedioci Devinske Nove Vasi još pamte kako su fanfare najavile prvi festival. Njime je simbolično potaknuto buđenje tamošnje, dotad pomalo zaboravljene, hrvatske zajednice. Bilo je to u lipnju 1989., uoči "baršunaste revolucije" koja je označila kraj epohe političkog jednoumlja. Zahvaljujući hrabrosti i požrtvovnosti mnogih naraštaja, festival priziva sjećanja na davne hrvatske pretke. Mahom težaci, radišni i vrijedni ljudi baštinili su od prošlosti svoje posebnosti, specifičnu čakavsko-ikavsku inačicu hrvatskog gradišćanskog narječja, napjeve, nošnje, tradicionalna jela. R.: Silvija Trnčević...

programme.title: Ben Fogle - the people of the wilderness / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: Ben Fogle: New Lives in the Wild - (S09, E01, Educational Program, England, 2022) The Pustolova Ben Fogle will spend a week at the Portuguese Highlands with Alex, 39), a British who used to sell outdoor equipment and live on the slope of the mountain. The psychic crisis and personal tragedy forced him to reconsider his life and move out of Britain. Ben will find out that Alex once survived without heating, electricity and water. Today, it remodges centuries -old buildings into an ideal farmhouse. She will tell Ben what challenges face by living in the hottest part of Portugal, and that, although he enjoys a solitary life, he is ready to hang out with like -minded people again. Among the like -minded people is a friend who helps him accomplish the plan to open the farm for guests. And she has an exceptional life story. R .: Natalie Wilkinson ... / Ben Fogle: New Lives in the Wild - (S09, E01, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2022) Pustolov Ben Fogle provest će tjedan u portugalskom gorju s Alexom (39), Britancem koji se nekoć bavio prodajom opreme za boravak na otvorenom, a danas samotno živi na obronku planine. Psihička kriza i osobna tragedija prisilile su ga da preispita život i odseli se iz Britanije. Ben će saznati kako je Alex svojedobno preživio bez grijanja, struje i vode. Danas preuređuje stoljetne građevine u idealan seoski dom. Ispričat će Benu s kakvim se izazovima suočava živeći u najtoplijem dijelu Portugala i kako je, premda uživa u samotnjačkom životu, spreman ponovno se družiti s istomišljenicima. Među istomišljenicima je i prijateljica koja mu pomaže ostvariti plan da farmu otvori za goste. I ona ima iznimnu životnu priču. R.: Natalie Wilkinson...

programme.title: Parenting in the animal world / Roditeljstvo u životinjskom svijetu
programme.desc: Parenthood - (E03, Nature. Film, England, 2025) On the open lawns of our planet, parents must constantly weigh between risk and gain when raising the next generation. Although abundant grass promises an abundance of food and places where the family can settle, open regions mean competition and predators. In England, the imaginative potter is exploiting all the grace of the lawn. Skillfully builds a clay cradle and is full to the top of the offspring for offspring they will never meet. In the Keni Park, Masai Mara Geprodica on the outdoor expanses of the cubs shows the hunting skills they will need when they grow up. It will be crucial when she needs help with the gnu cub. It is more difficult for others to achieve. On the open plains of Donji Zambezi, everything is on the side of the thirty -member pack of wild dogs. But parents have to instill a sense of discipline into their inexperienced cubs or hunting can perish. In India, Mother Langu, they must learn to be good nanny before they take on the role of parents - and to some it doesn't fall easy! It is a world where the balance between risk and gain is constantly changing: parents everywhere in Ravnice are forced to new and difficult decisions. In the Kalahari nests of brownish sparrows, the largest in the world, usually protecting the colony from the sun's heat. But unbearable thermal wave causes the breakdown of social order as dissatisfied neighbors begin to throw birds out of the nest. In Patagonia, the mother of Gvanak must join thousands of others in an attempt to arrive at winter feding sites for the survival of their descendants, in which they are disturbed by kilometers and kilometers of fences. Adversity and parents are increasingly difficult for animal parents, but people can provide simple solutions. Iako obilna trava obećava obilje hrane i mjesta na kojima se obitelj može nastaniti, otvoreni predjeli znače konkurenciju i grabežljivce. U Engleskoj domišljata lončarska osa iskorištava svu blagodat travnjaka. Vješto gradi glinenu kolijevku i puni je do vrha gusjenicama za potomstvo koje nikad neće upoznati. U kenijskom parku Masai Mara gepardica na otvorenom prostranstvu mladuncima pokazuje lovačke vještine koje će im trebati kad odrastu. Bit će to presudno kad joj zatreba pomoć u obaranju mladunca gnua. Drugima je ravnotežu teže postići. Na otvorenim ravnicama donjeg Zambezija, sve je na strani trideseteročlanog čopora divljih pasa. Ali roditelji moraju u svoje neiskusne mladunce usaditi osjećaj discipline ili im lov može propasti. U Indiji majke langura moraju naučiti biti dobre dadilje prije nego što preuzmu ulogu roditelja - a nekima to ne pada lako! To je svijet u kojem se ravnoteža između rizika i dobitka stalno mijenja: roditelji svugdje u ravnicama prisiljeni su na nove i teške odluke. U Kalahariju gnijezda smeđokapih vrabaca, najveća na svijetu, obično štite koloniju od sunčeve topline. No nepodnošljivi toplinski val uzrokuje raspad društvenog poretka jer nezadovoljni susjedi počinju izbacivati ptiće iz gnijezda. U Patagoniji majka gvanaka mora se pridružiti tisućama drugih u pokušaju da stigne na zimska hranilišta radi opstanka njihovih potomaka, u čemu ih ometaju kilometri i kilometri ograde. Nedaće i roditelje životinjskim je roditeljima sve teže zaobići, ali ljudi mogu pružiti jednostavna rješenja. R.: Elisabeth Oakham Ul.: Sir David Attenborough (Narrator)...

programme.title: Patina Mexican dishes / Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: Patis Mexican Table - (S12, E07, Educational Program, USA, 2023) Head of Passes Jinich again goes to the Mexican federal state of Yucatán, once the center of civilization of Maja, and explores the influence of this ancient people on its cultural and culinary heritage. U živahnom glavnom gradu Meridi otkriva kako se tijekom stoljeća majanska kuhinja mijenjala pod španjolskim utjecajem te postala jednom od najboljih kuhinja svijeta...

programme.title: Alan Titchmarsh: Fifty shades of green / Alan Titchmarsh: Pedeset nijansi zelene
programme.desc: 50 Shades of Green with Alan Titchmarsh - (Nature. Film, England, 2019) On the occasion of Alan Titchmarsh's 70th birthday and in honor of his fifty years of deeding, a special show was filmed, which represents fifty of his favorite things. In this special episode, we celebrate horticulture throughout the United Kingdom, from ancient oaks to seasonal plants whose inflorescence can be missed in a tulle. We go where it all started - in the Garden of Alan's grandfather, we travel across Britain: we will visit the royal Botanical gardens in Kew, Blenheim Palace and more, and will help us with the famous Mary Berry and Griff Rhys Jones. This lavish production full of interesting things is designed in honor of the most popular British garden ... / 50 Shades of Green With Alan Titchmarsh - (prirod. film, Engleska, 2019) U povodu proslave 70. rođendana Alana Titchmarsha i u čast njegovih pedeset godina bavljenja vrtlarstvom snimljena je posebna emisija koja predstavlja pedeset njemu najdražih stvari. U ovoj specijalnoj epizodi slavimo hortikulturu diljem Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva, od prastarih hrastova do sezonskih biljaka čiji cvat možete propustiti u tili čas. Krećemo ondje gdje je sve počelo - u vrtu Alanovog djeda, putujemo diljem Britanije: posjetit ćemo Kraljevske botaničke vrtove u Kewu, palaču Blenheim i još mnogo toga, a u svemu će nam pomoći slavni Mary Berry i Griff Rhys Jones. Ova raskošna produkcija prepuna zanimljivosti osmišljena je u čast najpopularnijem britanskom vrtlaru...

programme.title: Michel Roux: flavors of the French south / Michel Roux: Okusi francuskog juga
programme.desc: Michel Rouxs French Country Cooking - (S03, E01, Educational Program, England, 2022) Michel Roux will spend an unforgettable Christmas in Provence where he will host family and friends. And for Michel there is no Christmas without his favorite holiday dessert - Souffle with drunk plums with Armagnac. R .: James Harrison Ul.: Ela Nitzsche (Giselle), Elena Wilms (Tom), Jens Wendland (Gerard), Robin Brosch (Michel Roux) ... / Michel Rouxs French Country Cooking - (S03, E01, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2022) Michel Roux provest će nezaboravan Božić u Provansi gdje će ugostiti obitelj i prijatelje.
