Sa svojim četverogodišnjim pranećakom Tomom ispeći će medenjake za drvce. Ispeći će i posebno božićno drvo, ali središnji dio njegove božićne gozbe bit će pečena svinjetina. A za Michela nema Božića bez njegovog omiljenog blagdanskog deserta - soufflea s pijanim šljivama s Armagnacom. R.: James Harrison Ul.: Ela Nitzsche (Giselle), Elena Wilms (Tom), Jens Wendland (Gerard), Robin Brosch (Michel Roux)...

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: Lander - Menschen - Abenteuer - (S13, E01, Doc. Series, Germany, 2021) Stockholm archipelago includes more than 30,000 islands and islets. This world begins just a few kilometers from the center of Stockholm, extends far into the Baltic Sea and has retained a large part of its original charm. Because most of the island can only be reached by sea. This islands for many Swedes are an ideal place to spend the summer in their own country. But the Stockholm archipelago did not go for summer visitors and tourists. On the islet of Grinda is a rural estate of Maria Jorgenson. It is not easy to deal with agriculture in this islands at all. The cows driving a boat here are the usual scene. Sanham's Thimig Johansen lives on Sandhamn. The first day of summer is still celebrated here in the traditional way. Maritimeness left a mark everywhere on the islands and between them. Per Nakkk Roni for wreckage and a trace for well -preserved ships from the Hanzeth era. Like what kind of museum on the seabed, their remains are resting: anchors, cannonballs, clay cubes and ship boards ... / Lander - Menschen - Abenteuer - (S13, E01, dok. serija, Njemačka, 2021) Štokholmski arhipelag obuhvaća više od 30.000 otoka i otočića. Taj svijet počinje samo nekoliko kilometara od središta Stockholma, proteže se daleko u Baltičko more i zadržao je velik dio svojeg izvornog šarma. Jer na većinu otoka može se doći samo morskim putem. Ovo je otočje za mnoge Šveđane idealno mjesto za provođenje ljeta u vlastitoj zemlji. No Štokholmski arhipelag nije idila samo za ljetne posjetitelje i turiste. Na otočiću Grinda seosko je imanje Marije Jorgensson. Baviti se poljodjelstvom na ovom otočju uopće nije lako. Krave koje se voze brodom ovdje su uobičajen prizor. Na Sandhamnu živi Sanna Thimmig Johansen. Prvi dan ljeta ovdje se još slavi na tradicionalan način. Pomorstvo je ostavilo traga posvuda na otocima i između njih. Per Normark roni za olupinama i traga za dobro očuvanim brodovima iz hanzeatskog doba. Kao u kakvu muzeju na morskom dnu počivaju njihovi ostaci: sidra, topovske kugle, glineni ćupovi i brodske daske...

During that time, a discerned group of students works a mess, and the last season of the detective series is recorded in the city. Endeavour does not give up an investigation in Blenheim Vale. The team comes to shocking discoveries that point to a dark conspiracy in which the experts from Oxford are involved. Discoveries have their own price and thursday is forced to think of the safety of their loved ones. Р.: Нирпал Бхогал ул.: Shaun Evans (DS Endeavor Morse), James Bradshaw, James Debrыn), Sean Rigby (DS Jim Strange), Anton Lesser (Chief Superintendent Reginaldd Bright) ... / Endeavour - (S09, E02, igrana serija, Engleska, 2023) Oxford je preplavio val zločina. programme.title: Superpotier / Superpotjera
programme.desc: Supermore - (entertainment program, Croatia) in the superfluous for the first time, five hunters gathered in Supertim. Self -confident to the sky, all five work as one. They are ready to engage in battle with everyone who comes. They created one of the most powerful quiz teams on the planet, so the question is: Who has everything it takes to beat the hunters? The superfluous (in the original: Beat The Chasers) is a licensed television television format of knowledge quiz in which the competitor first provides a potential cash amount in the independent game answering questions with multiple choice. Provided that during the said independent game he manages to provide a certain amount of money, he continues with a competition in which he has the opportunity to win a cash prize by playing against two, three, four or all five hunters. The hunters are: Sven Marcelić, Morana Zibar, Kresimir Sucevic Međeral, Mladen Vukorepa and Dean Kotiga. R .: Danko Volarić ... / Superpotjera - (zabavni program, Hrvatska) U Superpotjeri je prvi put petero lovaca okupljeno u supertim. Samouvjereni do neba, svih petero rade kao jedan. Spremni su upustiti se u bitku sa svima koji dolaze. Stvorili su jedan od najmoćnijih kvizaških timova na planetu pa se postavlja pitanje: Tko ima sve što je potrebno da bi pobijedio lovce? Superpotjera (u izvorniku: Beat the Chasers) licencni je natjecateljski televizijski format kviza znanja u kojem natjecatelj najprije osigurava potencijalni novčani iznos u samostalnoj igri odgovaranja na pitanja s višestrukim izborom. Pod uvjetom da tijekom spomenute samostalne igre uspije osigurati određeni novčani iznos, nastavlja s natjecanjem u kojem ima priliku osvojiti novčanu nagradu igrajući protiv dva, tri, četiri ili svih pet lovaca. Lovci su: Sven Marcelić, Morana Zibar, Krešimir Sučević Međeral, Mladen Vukorepa i Dean Kotiga. R.: Danko Volarić...

programme.title: I wanted to hide / Htio sam se sakriti

programme.title: Let's take you ... Zagreb Classic / Vodimo vas ... Zagreb Classic
programme.desc: ZAGREB CLASSIC - (Movie Klas. Music, Croatia, 2025) The eighth Zagreb Classic Festival was held from June 19 to July 2, 2025. At King Tomislav Square, and the celebration of music under the clear sky, June 22 was joined by the Symphony Orchestra and the HRT Choir and the "Ivan Goran Kovačić" academic choir. Mediterranean sun-bathed melodies, fiery rhythms, sea blue, irresistible charm and temperament that erupts from each clock are the backbone of the concert of the Symphony Orchestra and the HRT Assembly under the guidance of one of the most prominent directions of the younger generation on the European scene, Gergely Duboczki. Educated at the Franz Liszt Academy in Budapest, highlighted as a creator of a series of contemporary and multican productions, now joins with HRT ensembles and excellent Croatian soloists who build great international careers. Violinist Sara Domjanic arrives from Germany, where she acts as the second concert master Dusseldorf Symphonics, Split tenor Tomislav Jukic is among the latest successes engaging with Cecilia Bartoli on the main stage of the opera in Zurich, and Bas-Bariton Benjamin Šuran has been produced in the Opera Mada Badani. With the Berlin Philharmonic and Kirill Petrenka. The program leads us from Spain and Italy to Dalmatia, starting with Andalusia inspired by España Emmanuel Chabrier, through orchestral masterpieces such as virtuoso introducing and Ronda Capriccios Camille Saint-Saëns and the enthusiastic idylls Roman-Korsakova. Some of the most beautiful human voice tunes belong to the Italian repertoire, so we will expect aria, duets and choirs from Opera Cavalleria Rustican Pietra Mascagni, the love drink of Gaetan Donizetti and Pagliacci Rugger Leoncavall, but also from the operas of Split aquarel. With our favorite cancone Naples - non -più and funiculì, funiculà - they bring us a warm, sunny south wing ... / Zagreb Classic - (film klas. glazbe, Hrvatska, 2025) Osmi po redu festival Zagreb Classic održao se od 19. lipnja do 2. srpnja 2025. na Trgu kralja Tomislava, a slavlju glazbe pod vedrim nebom, 22. lipnja pridružio se i Simfonijski orkestar te Zbor HRT-a te Akademski zbor "Ivan Goran Kovačić" tematskim koncertom pod nazivom Sjaj Mediterana. Mediteranskim suncem okupane melodije, vatreni ritmovi, morsko plavetnilo, neodoljivi šarm i temperament koji izbijaju iz svakoga takta okosnica su koncerta Simfonijskog orkestra i Zbora HRT-a pod vodstvom jednoga od najistaknutijih dirigenata mlađe generacije na europskoj sceni, Gergelya Duboczkog. Školovan na Akademiji Franz Liszt u Budimpešti, istaknut kao kreator niza suvremenih i multižanrovskih produkcija, sada se udružuje s ansamblima HRT-a i vrsnim hrvatskim solistima koji grade sjajne međunarodne karijere. Violinistica Sara Domjanić stiže iz Njemačke gdje djeluje kao druga koncertna majstorica Dusseldorfskih simfoničara, splitski tenor Tomislav Jukić među posljednjim uspjesima bilježi angažman uz Ceciliju Bartoli na glavnoj pozornici Opere u Zurichu, a bas-bariton Benjamin Šuran nastupio je u produkciji opere Madama Butterfly na Festivalu Baden-Baden uz Berlinsku filharmoniju i Kirilla Petrenka. Program nas vodi od Španjolske i Italije do Dalmacije, počevši od Andaluzijom nadahnute rapsodije España Emmanuela Chabriera, preko orkestralnih remek-djela poput virtuozne Introdukcije i Ronda capricciosa Camillea Saint-Saënsa i zanosne Idile Blagoja Berse do strastvene suite Španjolski capriccio Nikolaja Rimski-Korsakova. Neke od najljepših melodija za ljudski glas pripadaju dakako talijanskom repertoaru, pa nas očekuju arije, dueti i zborovi iz opera Cavalleria rusticana Pietra Mascagnija, Ljubavni napitak Gaetana Donizettija i I Pagliacci Ruggera Leoncavalla, ali i iz operete Spliski akvarel našega Ive Tijardovića. Uz omiljene napuljske kancone - Non tamo più i Funiculì, funiculà - donose nam toplo, osunčano okrilje juga...

programme.title: Talking to the rocks / Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: Talking to the rocks - (E04, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2024) This scientific and reciprocular film takes us through the rich geological past of Istria. We learn that numerous geological processes, rocks, minerals, soils, landscapes and other geological features have significantly influenced and still affect the life of this area from the economy to the rich cultural heritage. The story begins at the top of Vojak, at the Učka Nature Park in white Istria. The name was given to her solid and hard limestones built of the remains of a baptism of different organisms who lived in shallow subtropical and tropical seas. After that we head west, to another relief unit of Istria, to the area of ​​Gray Istria. The name owes the deposits of sedimentary gray rocks, deposited in the eocene period. In the area of ​​Gray Istria, the magical landscapes of Istrian towns on the tops of hills such as Motovun, Buzet or Boljun are famous. They thank their position with the imposing megalosilles of the sandstone on which they were built. Thus, geological material directly influenced the social development of this area. The third color of the Istrian Peninsula is red because of the particular soil, the reds, which is mostly in the world in Croatia, and in Istria the thickest layers are in Istria. A team of geologists presents us with the latest discovery of the world about how the redness actually originated. We will visit Rudokop near Rovinj in the area where the famous Kirmenjak has been removed for centuries, from which Venice and many other cities and monuments were built. In the underground quarry we will get to know the Istrian yellow, the most famous architectural and construction stone from Istria. In the 15th century, Juraj Dalmatinac built it in Italy. The eastern part of the Peninsula, the Labin area, known for coal, will also be an indispensable station. With the abundance of mine resources, we will discover why we proudly call the Boxit a Croatian national mineral. Following the geological traces on the Istrian peninsula, we will pass through four periods of rise in the Adriatic carbonate platform, the periods of its land phases when these different sediments and soil were created. AND... / Razgovor sa stijenama - (E04, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2024) Ovaj znanstveno-popularni film vodi nas kroz bogatu geološku prošlost Istre. Doznajemo kako su brojni geološki procesi, stijene, minerali, tla, pejzaži i druga geološka obilježja bitno utjecala i još utječu na život ovoga kraja od gospodarstva pa do bogate kulturne baštine. Priča započinje na vrhu Vojak, u Parku prirode Učka u Bijeloj Istri. Ime su joj dali čvrsti i tvrdi vapnenci izgrađeni od ostataka kršja različitih organizama koji su živjeli u plitkim suptropskim i tropskim morima. Nakon toga krećemo prema zapadu, u drugu reljefnu cjelinu Istre, na područje Sive Istre. Naziv duguje naslagama sedimentnih sivih stijena, taloženima u razdoblju eocena. Na području Sive Istre znameniti su magični krajolici istarskih gradića na vrhovima brežuljaka poput Motovuna, Buzeta ili Boljuna. Svoj položaj zahvaljuju impozantnim megaslojevima pješčenjaka na kojima su izgrađeni. Tako je geološka građa izravno utjecala na društveni razvoj ovoga kraja. Treća boja Istarskog poluotoka je crvena zbog osobitog tla, crvenice, koje najviše na svijetu ima u Hrvatskoj, a upravo su u Istri najdeblji slojevi. Tim geologa predstavlja nam najnovije svjetsko otkrić o tome kako je zapravo crvenica nastala. Posjetit ćemo rudokop u blizini Rovinja u kraju u kojem se stoljećima vadio slavni kirmenjak, od kojeg je sagrađena Venecija i mnogi drugi gradovi i spomenici. U podzemnom kamenolomu upoznat ćemo Istarski žuti, najpoznatiji arhitektonsko-građevni kamen iz Istre. Njime je u 15. stoljeću Juraj Dalmatinac gradio po Italiji. Nezaobilazna će postaja biti i istočni dio poluotoka, područje Labinštine, poznato po kopanju ugljena. Uz obilje rudnoga bogatstava, otkrit ćemo zbog čega boksit s ponosom zovemo hrvatskim nacionalnim mineralom. Prateći geološke tragove na Istarskom poluotoku proći ćemo četirima razdobljima izdizanja Jadranske karbonatne platforme, razdobljima njezinih kopnenih faza kada su ti različiti sedimenti i tla nastajali. I...

Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec...

programme.title: Talking to the rocks / Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: Talking to the rocks - (E04, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2024) This scientific and reciprocular film takes us through the rich geological past of Istria. We learn that numerous geological processes, rocks, minerals, soils, landscapes and other geological features have significantly influenced and still affect the life of this area from the economy to the rich cultural heritage. The story begins at the top of Vojak, at the Učka Nature Park in white Istria. The name was given to her solid and hard limestones built of the remains of a baptism of different organisms who lived in shallow subtropical and tropical seas. After that we head west, to another relief unit of Istria, to the area of ​​Gray Istria. The name owes the deposits of sedimentary gray rocks, deposited in the eocene period. In the area of ​​Gray Istria, the magical landscapes of Istrian towns on the tops of hills such as Motovun, Buzet or Boljun are famous. They thank their position with the imposing megalosilles of the sandstone on which they were built. Thus, geological material directly influenced the social development of this area. The third color of the Istrian Peninsula is red because of the particular soil, the reds, which is mostly in the world in Croatia, and in Istria the thickest layers are in Istria. A team of geologists presents us with the latest discovery of the world about how the redness actually originated. We will visit Rudokop near Rovinj in the area where the famous Kirmenjak has been removed for centuries, from which Venice and many other cities and monuments were built. In the underground quarry we will get to know the Istrian yellow, the most famous architectural and construction stone from Istria. In the 15th century, Juraj Dalmatinac built it in Italy. The eastern part of the Peninsula, the Labin area, known for coal, will also be an indispensable station. With the abundance of mine resources, we will discover why we proudly call the Boxit a Croatian national mineral. Following the geological traces on the Istrian peninsula, we will pass through four periods of rise in the Adriatic carbonate platform, the periods of its land phases when these different sediments and soil were created. AND... / Razgovor sa stijenama - (E04, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2024) Ovaj znanstveno-popularni film vodi nas kroz bogatu geološku prošlost Istre. Doznajemo kako su brojni geološki procesi, stijene, minerali, tla, pejzaži i druga geološka obilježja bitno utjecala i još utječu na život ovoga kraja od gospodarstva pa do bogate kulturne baštine. Priča započinje na vrhu Vojak, u Parku prirode Učka u Bijeloj Istri. Ime su joj dali čvrsti i tvrdi vapnenci izgrađeni od ostataka kršja različitih organizama koji su živjeli u plitkim suptropskim i tropskim morima. Nakon toga krećemo prema zapadu, u drugu reljefnu cjelinu Istre, na područje Sive Istre. Naziv duguje naslagama sedimentnih sivih stijena, taloženima u razdoblju eocena. Na području Sive Istre znameniti su magični krajolici istarskih gradića na vrhovima brežuljaka poput Motovuna, Buzeta ili Boljuna. Svoj položaj zahvaljuju impozantnim megaslojevima pješčenjaka na kojima su izgrađeni. Tako je geološka građa izravno utjecala na društveni razvoj ovoga kraja. Treća boja Istarskog poluotoka je crvena zbog osobitog tla, crvenice, koje najviše na svijetu ima u Hrvatskoj, a upravo su u Istri najdeblji slojevi. Tim geologa predstavlja nam najnovije svjetsko otkrić o tome kako je zapravo crvenica nastala. Posjetit ćemo rudokop u blizini Rovinja u kraju u kojem se stoljećima vadio slavni kirmenjak, od kojeg je sagrađena Venecija i mnogi drugi gradovi i spomenici. U podzemnom kamenolomu upoznat ćemo Istarski žuti, najpoznatiji arhitektonsko-građevni kamen iz Istre. Njime je u 15. stoljeću Juraj Dalmatinac gradio po Italiji. Nezaobilazna će postaja biti i istočni dio poluotoka, područje Labinštine, poznato po kopanju ugljena. Uz obilje rudnoga bogatstava, otkrit ćemo zbog čega boksit s ponosom zovemo hrvatskim nacionalnim mineralom. Prateći geološke tragove na Istarskom poluotoku proći ćemo četirima razdobljima izdizanja Jadranske karbonatne platforme, razdobljima njezinih kopnenih faza kada su ti različiti sedimenti i tla nastajali. I...

programme.title: On the edge of science / Na rubu znanosti
programme.desc: At the edge of science - (known. Pop. Series, Croatia, 2025) in accordance with trends, and money becomes part of the digital world. Through card and internet business, and with the appearance of cryptocurrencies, digital money already exists. But the novelty in this field is to create digital state currency. Currently, as many as 130 countries, which together make up 98 % of the world GDP, explore, develop or already implement digital currencies in its economies. This raises important questions - from the freedom of the choice of the individual and the surrender of the monetary system of private corporations, through the anonymity of the consumption, to the dependence of the constant availability of modern devices, electricity and the Internet. Trenutačno čak 130 zemalja, koje zajedno čine 98 % svjetskog BDP-a, istražuje, razvija ili već implementira digitalne valute u svojim gospodarstvima. Time se otvaraju važna pitanja - od slobode izbora pojedinca i predaje upravljanja monetarnim sustavom privatnim korporacijama, preko anonimnosti potrošnje, pa sve do ovisnosti o stalnoj dostupnosti modernih uređaja, električne energije i interneta. U sveopćoj žurbi prema izdavanju digitalnog novca središnjih banaka, vrijedi zastati i pokušati razumjeti: što sa sobom donosi takav novac i zašto se uvodi?...

Uz vrsne soliste na tamburi - Marina Jurića, Frana Brlekovića i Nikolu Vilusa - osebujnu aranžersku darovitost donijeli su nam Roberto Hren i Fran Brleković. R.: Tvrtko Grgić...

programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Book or Life - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2025) We present a "great book of lyric poetry", an anthology composed by poet Slobodan Blagojevic in three Tom, which for the first time in history includes the poetic traditions of Serbia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro and Croatia, in a time range of one millennium. The novel by Montenegrin writer Milorad Popovic is also literary fascinating, and already affirmed in Croatia; His new novel is the title "court square" towards the Square of the same name in Cetinje, that old capital of Montenegro. The new, fourth novel by Olja Knezevic "Strada Fortunata" received the Tportal for Best Novel and is dramatized for the third program of Croatian Radio. In it, she reaches for her own life experience, but although the storyteller, the protagonist and author of the novel are partially overlapping, this is not a classic automation. Like Olja Knezevic and Italian author Veronica Raimo play with autobiography and already in the title of the novel he claims "I'm lying when I go." Fourth Roman Veronica Raimo was a finalist for the Straga Award, and won in the category presented by Straga-offs Bookstore and the one given by young readers of Straga Giovani ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2025) Predstavljamo "Veliku knjigu lirske poezije", antologiju koju je sastavio pjesnik Slobodan Blagojević u tri toma, a koja prvi put u povijesti obuhvaća pjesničke tradicije Srbije, Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore i Hrvatske, i to u vremenskom rasponu od jednog milenija. Književno fascinantan je i roman crnogorskog književnika Milorada Popovića, već otprije afirmiranog i u Hrvatskoj; njegov je novi roman nosi naslov "Dvorski trg" prema istoimenom trgu na Cetinju, toj staroj prijestolnici Crne Gore. Novi, četvrti roman Olje Knežević "Strada fortunata" dobio je nagradu Tportala za najbolji roman i dramatiziran je za Treći program Hrvatskog radija. U njemu ona poseže u vlastito životno iskustvo, ali iako se pripovjedačica, protagonistica i autorica romana djelomično preklapaju, ovdje nije riječ o klasičnoj autofikciji. Poput Olje Knežević i talijanska autorica Veronica Raimo poigrava se s autobiografijom pa već u naslovu romana tvrdi "Lažem kad zinem". Četvrti roman Veronice Raimo bio je finalist za nagradu Strega, a pobijedio je u kategoriji koju dodjeljuju knjižari Strega-off i onoj koju dodjeljuju mladi čitatelji Strega Giovani...

programme.title: Simpsons / Simpsoni
programme.desc: The Simpsons - (S33, E09, crt. Series, USA, 2021) Simpsons, animated series with the longest service of broadcasting, a cultural institution with an extremely loyal and dedicated circle of fans. Intelligently written, subversively humorous and cute humorous, the series ridicules the environment, but also itself. She has won numerous awards. The Simpsons are also the current owners of two Guinnes records, the longest aired animated series and series with the most hosting stars. The Simpson family consists of: Father Homer, who works as an occupational safety inspector in a local nuclear power plant, Mother Marge, who tries to keep peace in the family, a naughty ten -year -old Bart, an intelligent saxophonist of eight -year -old Lisa and the smallest Maggie, which emotions expresses a pier. Over time, viewers met and loved the remaining rich and infrequent unusual world of characters living in Springfield.sumpsoni, designed by animator Matt Groening, first appeared in 1987. As a series of short stories in 30 seconds, Groening produced for The Tracy Ullman Show. They soon received their own series, broadcasting for the first time in the Christmas special special on December 17, 1989, and then in the regular date of January 14, 1990. R .: Mike B. Anderson Ul .: Castellaneta Day (Mail Carrier / Santas Little Helper / Squeaky Voiced Teen / Hans Moleman / Gramp Simpson / Groundskeeper Willie / Homer Simpson), Julie Kavneson (Marge Simpson), Nancy Cartwright (Bart Simpson) Hank Azaria (Charlie / FBI Agent #2 / Nutz Manager / Nutz App / Chief Wiggum) ... / The Simpsons - (S33, E09, crt. serija, SAD, 2021) Simpsoni, animirana serija s najduljim stažem emitiranja, kulturne institucije s izuzetno odanim i predanim krugom obožavatelja. Inteligentno pisana, subverzivno humoristična i simpatično duhovita, serija ismijava okolinu, ali i samu sebe. Dobitnica je brojnih nagrada. Simpsoni su uz to trenutačni vlasnici dva Guinnesova rekorda i to kao najdulje emitirana animirana serija i serija s najviše ugošćenih zvijezda. Obitelj Simpson čine: otac Homer, koji radi kao inspektor zaštite na radu u mjesnoj nuklearnoj elektrani, majka Marge, koja pokušava zadržati mir u obitelji, nestašni desetogodišnjak Bart, inteligentna saksofonistica osmogodišnja Lisa i najmanja Maggie, koja emocije izražava dudanjem. Gledatelji su s vremenom upoznali i zavoljeli preostali bogati i nerijetko neobični svijet likova koji žive u Springfieldu.Simpsoni, koje je osmislio animator Matt Groening, prvi su se put pojavili 1987. kao serija kratkih priča u 30 sekunda koje je Groening producirao za The Tracy Ullman Show. Uskoro su dobili vlastitu seriju emitiravši se prvi put u božićnom specijalu 17. prosinca 1989., a zatim i u redovnom terminu 14. siječnja 1990. Posjeduju svoju zvijezdu na holivudskoj Stazi slavnih, a 1. svibnja 2005. američka najzabavnija obitelj proslavila je tada rekordnu 350. epizodu. R.: Mike B. programme.title: In the atmosphere of the tambourine / U ozračju tambure
programme.desc: In the atmosphere of the tambourine - (Show Magazine, Croatia, 2024), the HRT tamburitza orchestra in its concert cycle, since 2015, also represents young talented musicians. Great young artists came to visit - students of a five -year -old tambourine instrumental study at the Zagreb Music Academy, a tambourine department. The concert was prepared with the mentorship of prof. Veljko Valentina Skorvage and Maestro Sinisa Leopold. The virtuoso solo skills were evoked by performing works by world and domestic authors in various stylish expressions. The players of the HRT Tamburitza orchestra and the Zagreb Music Academy, united in a unique tamburitza corpus, also accompanied the award-winning vocal soloists Tena Lončarević and Matej Predojević Petrić, who tried to arise by the greats of Jakov Gotovac, and the young clarinetist Ana-Maria Klasan performed Virtuoso variations Emila Cossetta. Along with the excellent soloists on the tambourine - Marin Juric, Fran Brlekovic and Nikola Vilus - the peculiar arranger donation was brought to us by Roberto Hren and Fran Brlekovic. R .: Tvrtko Grgić ... / U ozračju tambure - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2024) Tamburaški orkestar HRT-a u svome koncertnom ciklusu, od 2015., predstavlja i mlade talentirane glazbenike. U goste su došli sjajni mladi umjetnici - studenti petogodišnjeg instrumentalnog studija tambure na Muzičkoj akademiji u Zagrebu, Odsjek tambura. Koncert su pripremili uz mentorstvo prof. Veljka Valentina Škorvage i maestra Siniše Leopolda. Virtuozno solističko umijeće dočarali su izvodeći djela svjetskih i domaćih autora u različitim stilskim izričajima. Svirači Tamburaškog orkestra HRT-a i Muzičke akademije u Zagrebu, sjedinjeni u jedinstveni tamburaški korpus, popratili su i nagrađivane vokalne soliste Tenu Lončarević i Mateja Predojevića Petrića, koji su se okušali u arijama velikana Jakova Gotovca, a mlada klarinetistica Ana-Maria Klasan izvela je virtuozne Čardaš varijacije iz Međimurja Emila Cossetta. Uz vrsne soliste na tamburi - Marina Jurića, Frana Brlekovića i Nikolu Vilusa - osebujnu aranžersku darovitost donijeli su nam Roberto Hren i Fran Brleković. R.: Tvrtko Grgić...

programme.title: Talking to the rocks / Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: Talking to the rocks - (E05, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2024) in this story of the islands that are growing, which are also the youngest and oldest islands on the Adriatic, we will get to know the unique geological and geomorphological phenomena of the surplus archipelago. We will also go through the highest concentration of nature monuments and the protected landscapes of this - the last Oasis of the Mediterranean, as the Vis Archipelago declared the World Nature Protection Organization. We will start a journey with the famous travel writer, scientist and geologist Albert Fortis, who sailed 250 years ago and concluded that he was in the middle of a volcanic triangle. But although an apple islet like a black piramid from a volcanic diabetes rose over the sea, Fortis was still fooled. With the professional help of our guide, we will find out that these volcanic rocks of apples, Brussels and Palagruza found themselves there. We will get acquainted with the main feature of the surplus archipelago - with salt diapins. Find out what an ordinary kitchen salt can do, 220 million years ago, together with magmatic and volcanic rocks deep in the Earth's bark. We will walk around the landscaped geostasis, sail like Tin Ujevic around the island of Saints, visit Brusnik and collect new insights at the Komiš Pirates and Kemenice beaches overlooking the granddiozing natural amphitheater of the Bay of Komiš. We will look for traces of dinosaurs who were pushed by these tidal plains 100 million years ago. In addition to geology, we will be accompanied by a rich cultural heritage of this distant islands. So we will find out how the sand dunes from the younger Stone Age are connected with the best Croatian wine, Mali. Join us on a boat trip, on foot, through the caves of blue and green, on gravel bays and the highest peaks. Participants: Ph.D. Tvrtko Korbar, Scientific Advisor, Croatian Geological Institute; Filip Prelec, geologist in Geopark Vis Archipelago; Lana Schmidt, Executive Director of Geopark Viska Archipelago. R .: Lada Džidić Barić ... / Razgovor sa stijenama - (E05, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2024) U ovoj priči o otocima koji rastu, koji su ujedno i najmlađi i najstariji otoci na Jadranu upoznat ćemo jedinstvene geološke i geomorfološke pojave Viškoga arhipelaga. Ujedno ćemo proći kroz najveću koncentraciju spomenika prirode i zaštićenih krajolika ove - posljednje rajske oaze Mediterana, kako je Viški arhipelag proglasila Svjetska organizacija za zaštitu prirode. Započet ćemo putovanje sa znamenitim putopiscem, znanstvenikom i geologom Albertom Fortisom, koji je prije 250 godina plovio ovim krajem i zaključio da se nalazi usred vulkanskoga trokuta. No, premda se otočić Jabuka poput crne piramide od vulkanskoga dijabaza uzdiže nad morem, Fortis se ipak prevario. Uz stručnu pomoć našega vodiča doznat ćemo kako su se te vulkanske stijene Jabuke, Brusnika i Palagruže tu našle. Upoznat ćemo se s glavnim obilježjem Viškoga arhipelaga - solnim dijapirima. Saznati što sve može napraviti obična kuhinjska sol pokopana prije 220 milijuna godina zajedno s magmatskim i vulkanskim stijenama duboko u Zemljinoj kori. Prošetat ćemo se uređenim geostazama, ploviti poput Tina Ujevića oko otoka Sveca, posjetiti Brusnik i skupljati nove spoznaje na komiškim plažama Gusarica i Kemenice s pogledom na grandiozni prirodni amfiteatar Komiškoga zaljeva. Potražit ćemo tragove dinosaura koji su gacali ovim plimnim ravnicama prije 100 milijuna godina. Uz geologiju, pratit će nas i bogato kulturno nasljeđe ovoga udaljenoga otočja. Tako ćemo doznati kako su povezane pješčane dine iz mlađeg kamenog doba s ponajboljim hrvatskim vinom Plavcem malim. Pridružite nam se na putovanju brodom, pješice, kroz špilje modre i zelene, na šljunčane uvale i najviše vrhove. Sudjeluju: dr. sc. Tvrtko Korbar, znanstveni savjetnik, Hrvatski geološki institut; Filip Prelec, geolog u Geoparku Viški arhipelag; Lana Schmidt, izvršna direktorica Geoparka Viški arhipelag. R.: Lada Džidić Barić...

programme.title: As it is said / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: As it is said - (E13, Show Magazine, Croatia, 2025) The HTV Education and Science Department in cooperation with the Croatian Language Institute has recorded about thirty videos in which, in addition to linguistic advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language such as young people and foreign words in the Croatian language are addressed. programme.title: Talking to the rocks / Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: Talking to the rocks - (E05, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2024) in this story of the islands that are growing, which are also the youngest and oldest islands on the Adriatic, we will get to know the unique geological and geomorphological phenomena of the surplus archipelago. We will also go through the highest concentration of nature monuments and the protected landscapes of this - the last Oasis of the Mediterranean, as the Vis Archipelago declared the World Nature Protection Organization. We will start a journey with the famous travel writer, scientist and geologist Albert Fortis, who sailed 250 years ago and concluded that he was in the middle of a volcanic triangle. But although an apple islet like a black piramid from a volcanic diabetes rose over the sea, Fortis was still fooled. With the professional help of our guide, we will find out that these volcanic rocks of apples, Brussels and Palagruza found themselves there. We will get acquainted with the main feature of the surplus archipelago - with salt diapins. Find out what an ordinary kitchen salt can do, 220 million years ago, together with magmatic and volcanic rocks deep in the Earth's bark. We will walk around the landscaped geostasis, sail like Tin Ujevic around the island of Saints, visit Brusnik and collect new insights at the Komiš Pirates and Kemenice beaches overlooking the granddiozing natural amphitheater of the Bay of Komiš. We will look for traces of dinosaurs who were pushed by these tidal plains 100 million years ago. In addition to geology, we will be accompanied by a rich cultural heritage of this distant islands. So we will find out how the sand dunes from the younger Stone Age are connected with the best Croatian wine, Mali. Join us on a boat trip, on foot, through the caves of blue and green, on gravel bays and the highest peaks. Participants: Ph.D. Tvrtko Korbar, Scientific Advisor, Croatian Geological Institute; Filip Prelec, geologist in Geopark Vis Archipelago; Lana Schmidt, Executive Director of Geopark Viska Archipelago. R .: Lada Džidić Barić ... / Razgovor sa stijenama - (E05, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2024) U ovoj priči o otocima koji rastu, koji su ujedno i najmlađi i najstariji otoci na Jadranu upoznat ćemo jedinstvene geološke i geomorfološke pojave Viškoga arhipelaga. Ujedno ćemo proći kroz najveću koncentraciju spomenika prirode i zaštićenih krajolika ove - posljednje rajske oaze Mediterana, kako je Viški arhipelag proglasila Svjetska organizacija za zaštitu prirode. Započet ćemo putovanje sa znamenitim putopiscem, znanstvenikom i geologom Albertom Fortisom, koji je prije 250 godina plovio ovim krajem i zaključio da se nalazi usred vulkanskoga trokuta. No, premda se otočić Jabuka poput crne piramide od vulkanskoga dijabaza uzdiže nad morem, Fortis se ipak prevario. Uz stručnu pomoć našega vodiča doznat ćemo kako su se te vulkanske stijene Jabuke, Brusnika i Palagruže tu našle. Upoznat ćemo se s glavnim obilježjem Viškoga arhipelaga - solnim dijapirima. Saznati što sve može napraviti obična kuhinjska sol pokopana prije 220 milijuna godina zajedno s magmatskim i vulkanskim stijenama duboko u Zemljinoj kori. Prošetat ćemo se uređenim geostazama, ploviti poput Tina Ujevića oko otoka Sveca, posjetiti Brusnik i skupljati nove spoznaje na komiškim plažama Gusarica i Kemenice s pogledom na grandiozni prirodni amfiteatar Komiškoga zaljeva. Potražit ćemo tragove dinosaura koji su gacali ovim plimnim ravnicama prije 100 milijuna godina. Uz geologiju, pratit će nas i bogato kulturno nasljeđe ovoga udaljenoga otočja. Tako ćemo doznati kako su povezane pješčane dine iz mlađeg kamenog doba s ponajboljim hrvatskim vinom Plavcem malim. Pridružite nam se na putovanju brodom, pješice, kroz špilje modre i zelene, na šljunčane uvale i najviše vrhove. Sudjeluju: dr. sc. Tvrtko Korbar, znanstveni savjetnik, Hrvatski geološki institut; Filip Prelec, geolog u Geoparku Viški arhipelag; Lana Schmidt, izvršna direktorica Geoparka Viški arhipelag. R.: Lada Džidić Barić...

programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Book or Life - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2025) We present a great book of lyric poetry - an anthology organized by poet Slobodan Blagojevic in three Tom. It is the first edition that covers the poetic traditions of Serbia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro and Croatia in a time range of one millennium. Literary is also fascinating and the new novel by Montenegrin author Milorad Popovic, a court square, named after the central square in Cetinje, the old capital of Montenegro. Fourth novel by Olja Knezevic, Strada Fortunat, is the winner of the T-Portal Award for Best Novel and is dramatized for the third program of Croatian Radio. The author reaches for her own life experience, but although the storyteller, the protagonist and the author are partially overlapping, it is not a classic automation. Like Olja Knezevic and the Italian author Veronica Raimo, she plays with autobiography - already in the title of the novel I claim to lie when Zinem. Her fourth novel was the finalist of the prestigious Straga Award and the winner in the two categories: Straga off, awarded by bookstores, and Straga Giovani, selected by young readers ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2025) Predstavljamo Veliku knjigu lirske poezije - antologiju koju je u tri toma priredio pjesnik Slobodan Blagojević. Riječ je o prvom izdanju koje obuhvaća pjesničke tradicije Srbije, Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore i Hrvatske u vremenskom rasponu od jednog tisućljeća. Književno je fascinantan i novi roman crnogorskog autora Milorada Popovića, Dvorski trg, nazvan prema središnjem trgu na Cetinju, staroj prijestolnici Crne Gore. Četvrti roman Olje Knežević, Strada fortunata, dobitnik je nagrade T-portala za najbolji roman te je dramatiziran za Treći program Hrvatskoga radija. Autorica u njemu poseže u vlastito životno iskustvo, no iako se pripovjedačica, protagonistica i autorica djelomično preklapaju, riječ nije o klasičnoj autofikciji. Poput Olje Knežević i talijanska autorica Veronica Raimo poigrava se autobiografijom - već u naslovu romana tvrdi Lažem kad zinem. Njezin četvrti roman bio je finalist prestižne nagrade Strega te pobjednik u dvjema kategorijama: Strega Off, koju dodjeljuju knjižari, i Strega Giovani, koju biraju mladi čitatelji...

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: Lander - Menschen - Abenteuer - (S13, E01, Doc. Series, Germany, 2021) Stockholm archipelago includes more than 30,000 islands and islets. This world begins just a few kilometers from the center of Stockholm, extends far into the Baltic Sea and has retained a large part of its original charm. Because most of the island can only be reached by sea. This islands for many Swedes are an ideal place to spend the summer in their own country. But the Stockholm archipelago did not go for summer visitors and tourists. On the islet of Grinda is a rural estate of Maria Jorgenson. It is not easy to deal with agriculture in this islands at all. Like what kind of museum on the seabed, their remains are resting: anchors, cannonballs, clay cubes and ship boards ... / Lander - Menschen - Abenteuer - (S13, E01, dok. serija, Njemačka, 2021) Štokholmski arhipelag obuhvaća više od 30.000 otoka i otočića. Taj svijet počinje samo nekoliko kilometara od središta Stockholma, proteže se daleko u Baltičko more i zadržao je velik dio svojeg izvornog šarma. Jer na većinu otoka može se doći samo morskim putem. Ovo je otočje za mnoge Šveđane idealno mjesto za provođenje ljeta u vlastitoj zemlji. No Štokholmski arhipelag nije idila samo za ljetne posjetitelje i turiste. Na otočiću Grinda seosko je imanje Marije Jorgensson. Baviti se poljodjelstvom na ovom otočju uopće nije lako. Krave koje se voze brodom ovdje su uobičajen prizor. Na Sandhamnu živi Sanna Thimmig Johansen. Prvi dan ljeta ovdje se još slavi na tradicionalan način. Pomorstvo je ostavilo traga posvuda na otocima i između njih. Per Normark roni za olupinama i traga za dobro očuvanim brodovima iz hanzeatskog doba. Kao u kakvu muzeju na morskom dnu počivaju njihovi ostaci: sidra, topovske kugle, glineni ćupovi i brodske daske...

programme.title: It's time for jazz / Vrijeme je za jazz
programme.desc: It is time for jazz - (music. Show, Croatia, 2025) at a time that does not suit cultural programs, marking a quarter of a century of the Liburnia Jazz Festival in Opatija is an event that awakens optimism. The festival celebrated its 25 years from July 4 to July 6, and preceded the presentation of the monograph "Liburnia Jazz: 25 years", which remains a permanent document on the importance of the festival. The Liburnia Jazz Festival was the first big step into the world of jazz for many local musicians, giving them the opportunity not only to perform, but also to share a stage with big world names like Joe Zawilanu, Hiromi, Mike Stern, Richard Bone, Marie Joao, Medeski, Martin and Wood, and last year. This special year, the festival also emphasized its role as a meeting place - gathering local and foreign musicians, different cultures and music traditions, which has always been an important component of his identity, along with music and various audiences ... / Vrijeme je za jazz - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2025) U vremenu koje ne pogoduje trajanju kulturnih programa, obilježavanje četvrt stoljeća Liburnia Jazz Festivala u Opatiji događaj je koji budi optimizam. Festival je svojih 25 godina proslavio od 4. do 6. srpnja, a prethodilo mu je i predstavljanje monografije "Liburnia Jazz: 25 godina", koja ostaje trajni dokument o značaju festivala. Liburnia Jazz Festival bio je prva velika stepenica u svijet jazza za mnoge lokalne muzičare, pružajući im priliku ne samo da nastupe, nego i da dijele pozornicu s velikim svjetskim imenima poput Joea Zawinula, Hiromi, Mikea Sterna, Richarda Bone, Marie Joao, Medeskija, Martina and Wooda, a prošle godine i Richarda Galliana. Ove posebne godine festival je naglasio i svoju ulogu mjesta susreta - okupljajući lokalne i inozemne glazbenike, različite kulture i muzičke tradicije, što je uvijek bila važna komponenta njegovog identiteta, zajedno s glazbom i različitim publikama...

programme.title: Out of format / Izvan formata
programme.desc: Out of the format - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2025), when seven years ago, before Christmas on the Republic Square, the F8 Gallery was opened at number 8, students of the Zagreb Academy of Dramatic Arts received the most beautiful holiday gift. In the past seven years, we have seen more than 40 exhibitions at this address that have gathered numerous visitors. And this is a confirmation that the F8 Gallery has outgrown the student gallery story and that it has become an important place that was missing on the Croatian photographic and artistic scene. These days, due to the risk of collapse of the facade and cracked sculptures on the Gallery building, the gallery had to move out. Agile professors and students of the Department of Photography have arranged a new exhibition space in the immediate vicinity and thus continued this beautiful gallery story. At the Gallery Studio and the Department of Photography, we talk to Professor Jelena Blagovic and photographer Gloria Lizda. And we were also at an interesting exam exhibition of students of the photo of Vid Redz and David Bakaric Mihaljevic ... / Izvan formata - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2025) Kada je prije sedam godina uoči Božića na Trgu Republike Hrvatske na broju 8 otvorena Galerija f8, studenti fotografije zagrebačke Akademije dramske umjetnosti dobili su najljepši blagdanski poklon. U proteklih sedam godina na toj smo adresi vidjeli više od 40 izložbi koje su okupljale brojne posjetitelje. A to je potvrda da je Galerija f8 prerasla studentsku galerijsku priču te da je postala važno mjesto koje je nedostajalo na hrvatskoj fotografskoj i umjetničkoj sceni. Ovih dana zbog opasnosti od urušavanja fasade i napuklih skulptura na zgradi Galerija se morala iseliti. Agilni profesori i studenti Katedre za fotografiju uredili su u neposrednoj blizini novi izložbeni prostor i tako nastavili ovu lijepu galerijsku priču. U studiju o Galeriji i Katedri za fotografiju ADU razgovaramo s profesoricom Jelenom Blagović i fotografkinjom Glorijom Lizde. A bili smo i na zanimljivoj ispitnoj izložbi studenata fotografije Vida Redže i Davida Bakarića Mihaljevića...

programme.title: Fever / Groznica
programme.desc: Rush! - (E03, Show Magazine, Australia, 2024) The episode studies the key role of wood throughout human history and that the search for this most deadverting goods, which is now the basis of the industry worth billions of dollars, dictates our history, present and future. By discovering the secret structures of trees, we study the resistance of wooden buildings in Japan and the importance of wooden ships for the formation of empires. Going to the future, we explore the role of wood in modern human activities and the transition of the construction industry to the environmentally conscious construction, emphasizing the timeless importance of wood as a fundamental resource and leader of innovation. R .: Rob Perry Ul .: Mark Backes (Kommentar) ... / Rush! - (E03, show magazin, Australija, 2024) Epizoda proučava ključnu ulogu drva kroz ljudsku povijest te kako potraga za tom najdrevnijom robom, koja je sada temelj industrije vrijedne milijarde dolara, diktira našu povijest, sadašnjost i budućnost. Otkrivajući tajne strukture stabala, proučavamo otpornost drvenih građevina u Japanu i važnost drvenih brodova za nastanak carstava. Prelazeći na budućnost, istražujemo ulogu drva u modernim ljudskim aktivnostima te prelazak građevinske industrije na ekološki osviještenu gradnju, naglašavajući bezvremensku važnost drva kao temeljnog resursa te predvodnika inovacije. R.: Rob Perry Ul.: Mark Backes (Kommentar)...

programme.title: Eternal Comedy Cycle: What did you do in war, Dad? / Vječni ciklus komedije: Što si radio u ratu, tata?
programme.desc: What did you do in the war, Daddy? - (Comedy, USA, 1966) World War II. Commander Lionel Cash (D. Shawn) is tasked with winning a village of many Italian soldiers with a smaller group of people. To their huge surprise, they are welcomed by the cheerful Italian commander Oppo (S. Fantoni), who immediately, without struggle, teaching both the village and the soldiers, but under one unusual condition. Namely, zap. Cash villagers and Italian soldiers should be allowed to maintain another major celebration. Cash, known for holding on the rules firmly, reluctantly agreed after a long persuasion. At the celebration, fun and American and Italian soldiers and even Cash himself get drunk together. However, the agreed surrender the next day of waste due to the municipality of jealousy, because his previously dear Gin (G. Rali) spent the night with Commander Cash. War journalists photograph a "fight" from the air and there is a great misunderstanding and the whole world thinks that there is a great battle for survival in the village. Topped up in lies, both sides agree that they will continue to play the fight for the village ... R .: Blake Edwards Ul.: James Coburn (Lt. Christian), Dick Shawn (CAPT. Lionel Cash), Sergio Fantoni (Cap. Oppo), Giovanna Ralli (Gina Romano), Aldo Ray (SGT. RIZZO) ... / What Did You Do in the War, Daddy? - (komedija, SAD, 1966) Drugi svjetski rat. Zapovjednik Lionel Cash (D. Shawn) dobiva zadatak da s manjom grupom ljudi osvoji selo puno talijanskih vojnika. Na njihovo golemo iznenađenje dočekuje ih veseli talijanski zapovjednik Oppo (S. Fantoni) koji odmah, bez borbe, predaje i selo i vojnike, no pod jednim neobičnim uvjetom. Naime, zap. Cash seljanima i talijanskim vojnicima treba dopustiti da održe još jednu veliku proslavu. Cash, poznat po tome da se čvrsto drži pravila, nakon dugog nagovaranja nevoljko pristane. Na proslavi se zajedno napiju i zabave i američki i talijanski vojnici, pa čak i sam Cash. Međutim, dogovorena predaja sljedeći dan otpada zbog Oppove ljubomore, jer je njegova dotadašnja draga Gina (G. Rali) noć provela sa zapovjednikom Cashom. Ratni novinari fotografiraju "borbu" iz zraka te dolazi do velikog nesporazuma i cijeli svijet misli kako se u selu odvija velika bitka za opstanak. Zapletene u laži, obje se strane dogovore kako će i dalje glumiti borbu za selo... R.: Blake Edwards Ul.: James Coburn (Lt. Christian), Dick Shawn (Capt. Lionel Cash), Sergio Fantoni (Capt. Oppo), Giovanna Ralli (Gina Romano), Aldo Ray (Sgt. Rizzo)...

programme.title: Simpsons / Simpsoni
programme.desc: The Simpsons - (S33, E10, crt. Series, USA, 2021) Simpsons, animated series with the longest service of broadcasting, cultural institutions with an extremely loyal and dedicated circle of fans. Intelligently written, subversively humorous and cute humorous, the series ridicules the environment, but also itself. She has won numerous awards. The Simpsons are also the current owners of two Guinnes records, the longest aired animated series and series with the most hosting stars. The Simpson family consists of: Father Homer, who works as an occupational safety inspector in a local nuclear power plant, Mother Marge, who tries to keep peace in the family, a naughty ten -year -old Bart, an intelligent saxophonist of eight -year -old Lisa and the smallest Maggie, which emotions expresses a pier. Over time, viewers met and loved the remaining rich and infrequent unusual world of characters living in Springfield.sumpsoni, designed by animator Matt Groening, first appeared in 1987. As a series of short stories in 30 seconds, Groening produced for The Tracy Ullman Show. They soon received their own series, broadcasting for the first time in the Christmas special special on December 17, 1989, and then in the regular date of January 14, 1990. R .: Mike B. Inteligentno pisana, subverzivno humoristična i simpatično duhovita, serija ismijava okolinu, ali i samu sebe. Dobitnica je brojnih nagrada. Simpsoni su uz to trenutačni vlasnici dva Guinnesova rekorda i to kao najdulje emitirana animirana serija i serija s najviše ugošćenih zvijezda. Obitelj Simpson čine: otac Homer, koji radi kao inspektor zaštite na radu u mjesnoj nuklearnoj elektrani, majka Marge, koja pokušava zadržati mir u obitelji, nestašni desetogodišnjak Bart, inteligentna saksofonistica osmogodišnja Lisa i najmanja Maggie, koja emocije izražava dudanjem. Gledatelji su s vremenom upoznali i zavoljeli preostali bogati i nerijetko neobični svijet likova koji žive u Springfieldu.Simpsoni, koje je osmislio animator Matt Groening, prvi su se put pojavili 1987. kao serija kratkih priča u 30 sekunda koje je Groening producirao za The Tracy Ullman Show. Uskoro su dobili vlastitu seriju emitiravši se prvi put u božićnom specijalu 17. prosinca 1989., a zatim i u redovnom terminu 14. siječnja 1990. Posjeduju svoju zvijezdu na holivudskoj Stazi slavnih, a 1. svibnja 2005. američka najzabavnija obitelj proslavila je tada rekordnu 350. epizodu. R.: Mike B. Anderson Ul.: Dan Castellaneta (Homer Simpson / Grampa Simpson / Barney Gumble / Don Castellaneta / Louie), Julie Kavner (Marge Simpson), Nancy Cartwright (Bart Simpson), Yeardley Smith (Lisa Simpson), Hank Azaria (Johnny Tightlips / Luigi Risotto / Chief Wiggum / Moe Szyslak)...

The introductory conference was recently held on the occasion of this project. Jaskovo is a small settlement within the City of Ozalj in Karlovac County. It was first mentioned in historical records back in 1433. It is in this ancient region that the economy of the Kovac family is located, which has a high -planned Scottish cattle in open pastures in free cultivation. In addition to cattle, the family grows in an eco -friendly pumpkin, nuts and hazelnuts. We also bring foreign news. A pearl series of islands and islets called the Hell Islands is a protected nature monument in the category of significant landscape since 1968. In his bays and straits and today the meadows of Posidonia are still growing ... / Eko zona - (E639, prirod. film, Hrvatska) U tijeku su radovi na revitalizaciji Arboretuma Opeka u općini Vinica pokraj Varaždina. Osim goveda na ekološki način obitelj uzgaja i tikve, orahe i lješnjake. Donosimo i strane vijesti. programme.title: View across the border - Croats in BiH / Pogled preko granice - Hrvati u BiH
programme.desc: View across the border - Croats in BiH - (Educational Program, Croatia) - Bosnia and Herzegovina has been able to accept the reform program at the last minute and thus save the loss of an additional 108 million euros provided for by EU growth plan for the country. However, there are nowhere near the problems, especially those of the political nature who have been burdened by BiH for years. On the annual clause of the HDZ of Bosnia and Herzegovina, held last week in Neum, there was also talk about the continuation of activities on the European Road of BiH. - Health Minister Irena Hrstic and regional development and EU funds, Natasa Mikus Zigman, visited Mostar last week. As part of the visit, they toured the University Clinical Hospital of Mostar. They also participated in the presentation of a cross -border cooperation project called "Lifegate", where they submitted a contract with a total value of EUR 9.5 million. - The Catholic School Center in Tuzla marked 30 years of existence. The General High School started operating in November 1995, and in 2001 classes in elementary school began. Currently, these two KCC schools are attended by about 650 students, employing 82 employees. At the end of last year, among 17 schools in Tuzla Canton, this school took the first place in the quality of education. - Many places in Bosanska Posavina, including the middle Slatina near Shamac, have a similar story, the population has been exiled in the war, and the church and a large number of houses have been destroyed. With the occupation of the locals, a new church was built, houses are being renovated and locals return to their area. This is evidenced by the newly built building of the Croatian Cultural Center. - And in Bosanski Brod, the 33th anniversary was marked from the fall of that city. After a great sacrifice and 400 lost lives and 1200 wounded veterans, a Bosnian ship fell into hostile hands that day. In memory of all the killed and missing veterans, as well as civilian victims of the war, wreaths and candles were laid in the city cemetery. Association of Volunteers and Veterans 101 ... / Pogled preko granice - Hrvati u BiH - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) - Bosna i Hercegovina u posljednjem je trenutku uspjela prihvatiti program reformi i na taj način spasiti gubitak dodatnih 108 milijuna eura predviđenih Planom rasta EU-a za tu zemlju. No, time ni blizu nisu riješeni problemi, osobito oni političke prirode koji godinama opterećuju BiH. Na godišnjoj klauzuri HDZ-a Bosne i Hercegovine, održanoj prošloga tjedna u Neumu, govorilo se i o nastavku aktivnosti na europskom putu BiH. - Ministrice zdravstva Irena Hrstić i regionalnog razvoja i fondova EU-a Nataša Mikuš Žigman, prošli su tjedan posjetile Mostar. U sklopu posjeta obišle su Sveučilišnu kliničku bolnicu Mostar. Sudjelovale su i na predstavljanju projekta prekogranične suradnje pod nazivom "LifeGate", gdje su predale ugovor ukupne vrijednosti 9,5 milijuna eura. - Katolički školski centar u Tuzli obilježio je 30 godina postojanja. Opća gimnazija započela je s radom u studenom 1995., a 2001. počela je i nastava u osnovnoj školi. Trenutačno, te dvije škole KŠC-a pohađa oko 650 učenika, a u njima su zaposlena 82 djelatnika. Potkraj prošle godine, među 17 škola u tuzlanskom kantonu, ta je škola zauzela prvo mjesto po kvaliteti obrazovanja. - Mnoga mjesta u Bosanskoj Posavini, pa tako i Srednja Slatina kod Šamca imaju sličnu priču, stanovništvo je u ratu prognano, a crkva i velik broj kuća uništeni su. Zauzimanjem mještana izgrađena je nova crkva, obnavljaju se kuće i mještani se vraćaju u svoj kraj. O tome svjedoči i novoizgrađena zgrada Hrvatskog kulturnog centra. - A u Bosanskom Brodu obilježena je 33. godišnjica od pada toga grada. Nakon velike žrtve i 400 izgubljenih života te 1200 ranjenih branitelja, tog dana u neprijateljske je ruke pao Bosanski Brod. U spomen na sve poginule i nestale branitelje, kao i civilne žrtve rata, na Gradskom groblju položeni su vijenci i upaljene svijeće. Udruga dragovoljaca i veterana 101...

programme.title: Cycling: Paris-Tours / Cykling: Paris-Tours
programme.desc: The cycling season is nearing its end, but before the bike is put in the garage, one of the sport's biggest classics is missing: Paris-Tours. This year, it is the 119th edition of the race that is called the 'Sprinter's Classic', as the race has often ended in a sprinter show. The race ends at Avenue de Grammont in Tours. A mythical place for sprinters. / Cykelsæsonen nærmer sig sin afslutning, men inden cyklen bliver sat i garagen, mangler en af sportens største klassikere: Paris-Tours. programme.desc: The giant Sasquatch (Cooper) leaves his home in the city to embark on a new adventure in the forest, where he meets (Bobby) and they become friends and go on adventures to learn about the beautiful wildlife. / يترك الساسكواتش العملاق (كوبر) منزله في المدينة ليخوض مغامرة جديدة في الغابة، حيث يقابل (بوبي) ويصبحان صديقين ويخوضان مغامرات للتعرف على الحياة البرية الجميلة.

programme.title: Edmond and Lucy / Edmond and Lucy
programme.desc: The events revolve around the squirrel (Edmund) and the bear (Lucy), who live an adventurous life in their home in the forest, where nature is their best playmate. / تدور الأحداث حول السنجاب (إدموند) والدبة (لوسي)، واللذين يعيشان حياة مليئة بالمغامرات في منزلهما في الغابة، حيث تكون الطبيعة هي أفضل رفيقة لهما في اللعب.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas / Santiago of the Seas
programme.desc: The action follows Santiago, an 8-year-old pirate, and his crew as they embark on rescue operations, discover hidden treasures and keep the high Caribbean safe. / يتبع العمل سانتياجو، وهو قرصان يبلغ من العمر 8 سنوات، وطاقمه وهم يشرعون في عمليات الإنقاذ واكتشاف الكنوز المخبأة والحفاظ على أعالي البحر الكاريبي آمنًا.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S6 / PAW Patrol S6
programme.desc: This season, the puppies intervene to return three penguins who were carried away by the ice from their home. The disappearance of honey from the town causes everyone to panic, before the mayor gets stuck in a valley in the remote mountains and needs quick intervention. / في هذا الموسم تتدخل الجراء لإعادة ثلاثة بطاريق حملهم الجليد بعيدًا عن منزلهم، ويتسبب اختفاء العسل من البلدة في هلع الجميع، قبل أن يعلق العمدة في وادٍ بالجبال النائية، ويحتاج لتدخل سريع.

programme.title: The Wawies / The Wawies
programme.desc: An animated series that takes us to the small world of Wawa Land, which contains the cute Whooos creatures, which roam over every city around the world to explore and enjoy. / مسلسل ﺭﺳﻮﻡ ﻣﺘﺤﺮﻛﺔ، يأخذنا إلى عالم واوا لاند الصغير الذي يحتوي على مخلوقات الواويز اللطيفة، والتي تطوف فوق كل مدينة حول العالم للاستكشاف والاستمتاع.

programme.title: Except me, part 2 / إلا أنا ج2
programme.desc: A drama inspired by life stories. Each story is presented in ten episodes that discusses issues of concern to society in general and women’s issues in particular, and revolves around several stories, including (The House of Glory), (My Story with Time), and (A Taste of the World). / دراما مستوحاة من قصص الحياة، كل قصة تقدم في عشر حلقات تناقش قضايا تهم المجتمع بصفة عامة وقضايا المرأة بصفة خاصة، وتدور في عدة حكايات منها (بيت العز) و(حكايتي مع الزمان) و(طعم الدنيا).

programme.title: Fires of envy / نيران الحسد
His eyes are Black Sea / Gozleri Karadeniz
Far City / Uzak Sehir
programme.desc: A woman arrives with her son to her late husband's homeland to bury his body and leave in peace, but his influential family prevents her from leaving and fights occur that reveal many dark secrets. / تصل امرأة مع ابنها إلى موطن زوجها الراحل لدفن جثمانه والمغادرة بسلام، لكن عائلته ذات النفوذ تمنعها من المغادرة وتحدث معارك تُظهر الكثير من الأسرار المظلمة.

programme.title: Family Secrets / Family Secrets
programme.desc: The work takes place in a dramatic context, as a lawyer and a prosecutor must work together to investigate a murder to find the killer, which creates an irreversible breaking point in their lives. / يدور العمل في إطار درامي، حيث يتعين على محامي ومدعي العام العمل معًا بالتحقيق في جريمة قتل للعثور على القاتل، مما يخلق نقطة انهيار لا رجعة فيها في حياتهما.

programme.title: Client / العميل
programme.desc: The story of the series revolves around two brothers, Amir and Wissam, who have been separated by fate since childhood. Amir grows up to become a police officer, but joins a gang as part of a secret operation. While his brother Wissam, who was kidnapped when he was a child, grows up to become part of the same gang. Unbeknownst to them, the two brothers work together without knowing their true selves, and their fates are intertwined in a thrilling, suspense-filled setting. / تدور قصة المسلسل حول الأخوين أمير ووسام الذين يفرقهما القدر منذ الصغر، يكبر أمير ليصبح ضابط شرطة، لكنه ينضم لعصابة كجزء من عملية سرية. بينما أخوه وسام، الذي اختطف عندما كان طفلاً، يكبر ليصبح جزءً من نفس العصابة. بدون علمهما، يعمل الأخوان معًا دون معرفة حقيقتهما، ويتشابك مصيرهما في إطار مثير مليء بالتشويق.

programme.title: Secret Part 2: Challenge / سر ج2: التحدي
programme.desc: Amer Badran's battle begins after his release from prison to confront Detective Jad again, and to work with the Don in the contraband trade, and events escalate. / تبدأ معركة عامر بدران بعد خروجه من الحبس لمواجهة المحقق جاد من جديد، والعمل مع الدون في تجارة الممنوعات لتتصاعد الأحداث.

programme.title: Inheritance Part 3 / الميراث ج3
programme.desc: Overnight, the conditions in this part change. With Haifa’s reappearance, Youssef decides to reconcile his calculations, marry her, and forgive her, while fire breaks out between Dima and Majed and they divorce, and Sahar decides to take revenge on everyone who caused her son’s death. / ما بين ليلة وضحاها تتبدل الأحوال في هذ الجزء، فمع عودة هيفاء للظهور مرة أخرى يقرر يوسف إعادة حساباته والزواج منها ومسامحتها، في حين تشتعل النيران بين ديما وماجد ويقع الطلاق بينهما، وتقرر سحر الانتقام من كل من تسبب في وفاة ابنها.

programme.title: Fires of envy / نيران الحسد
His eyes are Black Sea / Gozleri Karadeniz
Far City / Uzak Sehir
programme.desc: A woman arrives with her son to her late husband's homeland to bury his body and leave in peace, but his influential family prevents her from leaving and fights occur that reveal many dark secrets. / تصل امرأة مع ابنها إلى موطن زوجها الراحل لدفن جثمانه والمغادرة بسلام، لكن عائلته ذات النفوذ تمنعها من المغادرة وتحدث معارك تُظهر الكثير من الأسرار المظلمة.

programme.title: Family Secrets / Family Secrets
programme.desc: The work takes place in a dramatic context, as a lawyer and a prosecutor must work together to investigate a murder to find the killer, which creates an irreversible breaking point in their lives. / يدور العمل في إطار درامي، حيث يتعين على محامي ومدعي العام العمل معًا بالتحقيق في جريمة قتل للعثور على القاتل، مما يخلق نقطة انهيار لا رجعة فيها في حياتهما.

programme.title: Client / العميل
programme.desc: The story of the series revolves around two brothers, Amir and Wissam, who have been separated by fate since childhood. Amir grows up to become a police officer, but joins a gang as part of a secret operation. While his brother Wissam, who was kidnapped when he was a child, grows up to become part of the same gang. Unbeknownst to them, the two brothers work together without knowing their true selves, and their fates are intertwined in a thrilling, suspense-filled setting. / تدور قصة المسلسل حول الأخوين أمير ووسام الذين يفرقهما القدر منذ الصغر، يكبر أمير ليصبح ضابط شرطة، لكنه ينضم لعصابة كجزء من عملية سرية. بينما أخوه وسام، الذي اختطف عندما كان طفلاً، يكبر ليصبح جزءً من نفس العصابة. بدون علمهما، يعمل الأخوان معًا دون معرفة حقيقتهما، ويتشابك مصيرهما في إطار مثير مليء بالتشويق.

programme.title: H Dabooor / H دبووور
programme.desc: Haitham Dabour (Ahmed Mekki) is a spoiled, condescending, lazy, reckless, and careless young man. He frequents discos and neglects his university studies. Whenever he sees a distinctive character in a movie, he orders his driver, Sirianussi Zaghloul (Lotfi Labib), to wear her costume, like the character Zorro, Superman, and the skirt of a Scottish organist. H. Dabbour was living with his father, Dabour (Hassan Hosni), the owner of a cosmetics company, who had recently produced “Hairy Hair” shampoo, and he wanted his son H. Dabbour to be by his side, so he appointed him as general manager of the company, which angered Dr. Shaarawy (Moataz Al-Tuni), who works in the company, and was hoping for the position, and because Shaarawy is an opportunist and has no conscience, he betrayed Dabbour, and sought refuge with his owner. The competing company, Ms. Latifa Al-Baghdadi (Hala Fakher), sold her the new shampoo package, and did not obtain a Ministry of Health permit for it. Thirty years ago, Dabour had been working in a cosmetics company owned by Miss Latifa’s father. The latter offered herself to the young man Dabour, but he rejected her, left her father’s company, and opened his own small company, which grew until it became a competitor to her father’s company. Now Latifa wants to take revenge on Dabour, and stop his company’s superiority over hers, so she bought Shaarawi’s name and hid the papers for the new shampoo, which was introduced in The market, and Latifa arranged some harm to the users, and since the shampoo was not authorized by the Ministry of Health, Dabbour was arrested, and his money and possessions were seized, and H. Dabbour became on the street, not having enough food for his day, and his closest friends, whom he was spending on, abandoned him, and he was forced to resort to his driver, Suryanusi, who lives in a popular neighborhood, with his beautiful, obese young daughter, the lawyer, Rouh. (Engy Wijdan), and H. Dabbour was forced to give up his pride and the proud life he was living, sharing their lives with the poor, sleeping on the floor, and using municipal bathrooms. He met Safwat (Mohamed Abdel Moati), the owner of the video tape store, and Kalusha (Sameh Hussein), the naive thug. In order to earn his living, he worked in several jobs that he did not succeed in, such as selling a microbus and being a distribution worker. The stove pipes, a barber and a carpenter assistant, and the thug Kalusha participated in impersonating the arrested drug dealer Abu Lebda. H. Dabour decided to transform into a positive character, and work to prove his father’s innocence and release him from prison. Under the supervision of Miss Latifa, he witnessed Dr. Shaarawi, who implicated his father in the shampoo incident, so he kidnapped Shaarawi, with the help of his companions Safwat, Kalousha, and Sirianusi, and the lawyer, Arawah, who took charge of defending Dabour the Great, and to torturing Shaarawi and threatening him with immorality in him. He confessed to all Something, and that the shampoo file, was in a nice company, and when they robbed the company at night, the police raided them, and Sirianussi was arrested, after everyone had fled. What was now required was to prove Dabour and Sirianussi’s innocence, and to get them out of prison. H did not give up and changed completely. He shaved off his thick hair and attended, with his new companions, a masquerade party held by Miss Latifa, on the occasion of her purchase of 65% of Dabour’s shares. They cut off the electricity at the party, kidnapped Latifa and threatened her, until she confessed to what she had done in Dabour’s shampoo and burned registration papers. The lotion was in the Ministry of Health, and it was purchased by Sharawi. The police, as usual, were hiding behind the door, recorded Latifa’s confessions, and arrested her. The prosecution released Dabbour Al-Kabir and Sirianussi, and H. Dabbour married Rawah. (H. Dabour) / هيثم دبور (أحمد مكي) شاب مدلل ومتعالي وكسول ومستهتر ولاهي، يتردد على المراقص ويهمل دراسته الجامعية، وكلما شاهد شخصية مميزة فى فيلماً، أمر سائقه سيريانوسي زغلول (لطفي لبيب)، بإرتداء زيها، مثل شخصية زورو، سوبرمان و تنورة عازف الأرغن الإسكتلندي. كان إتش دبووور يعيش مع والده دبور (حسن حسني)، صاحب شركة مستحضرات التجميل، والذى أنتج مؤخراً شامبو " هيري هير"، ويريد أن يكون إبنه إتش دبور بجانبه، فعينه مديراً عاماً للشركة، مما أثار حنق الدكتور شعراوي (معتز التوني)، الذى يعمل فى الشركة، وكان يأمل فى المنصب، ولأن شعراوي إنتهازي ولا ضمير له، فقد خان دبور، ولجأ لصاحبة الشركة المنافسة الآنسة لطيفة البغدادي (هاله فاخر)، وباع لها ملف الشامبو الجديد، ولم يستخرج له تصريح وزارة الصحة. كان دبور منذ ثلاثون عاماً يعمل فى شركة مستحضرات تجميل، يملكها والد الآنسة لطيفة، والأخيرة عرضت نفسها على الشاب دبور، ولكنه رفضها، وترك شركة والدها، وإفتتح شركته الصغيرة الخاصة، والتى نمت حتى أصبحت منافسة لشركة والدها، والآن تريد لطيفة الإنتقام من دبور، وإيقاف تفوق شركته على شركتها، فإشترت ذمة شعراوي، وأخفت أوراق الشامبو الجديد، الذى طرح فى السوق، ودبرت له لطيفه بعض الأضرار على المستخدمين، وبما أن الشامبو غير مصرح به من وزارة الصحة، فقد تم القبض على دبور، والتحفظ على امواله وممتلكاته، واصبح إتش دبووور فى الشارع، لا يمتلك قوت يومه، وتخلي عنه أقرب أصدقاءه، الذين كان ينفق عليهم، وإضطر إلى اللجوء لسائقه سريانوسي، الذى يقيم فى حي شعبي، مع إبنته الشابة الجميلة البدينة المحامية ارواح (إنجي وجدان)، وإضطر إتش دبووور للتنازل عن كبرياءه، وحياة العز التى كان يعيشها، ومشاركة الفقراء حياتهم، والنوم على الأرض، وإستخدام الحمامات البلدية، وتعرف على صفوت (محمد عبدالمعطي)، صاحب محل شرائط الفيديو، وكالوشا (سامح حسين)، البلطجي الساذج، ولكي يكتسب قوت يومه عمل فى عدة أعمال لم يوفق فيها، مثل تباع على ميكروباص وعامل توزيع أنابيب البوتاجاز وحلاق ومساعد نجار، وشارك البلطجي كالوشا فى إنتحال شخصية، تاجر المخدرات المقبوض عليه أبو لبدة. قرر إتش دبور التحول لشخصية إيجابيه، والعمل على إثبات براءة والده، وإخراجه من السجن، وبمراقبة الآنسة لطيفه، شاهد لديها دكتور شعراوي، الذى ورط والده فى واقعة الشامبو، فقام بخطف شعراوي، بمساعدة رفاقه صفوت وكالوشا وسيريانوسي والمحامية ارواح، التى تولت الدفاع عن دبور الكبير، وبتعذيب شعراوي وتهديده بالفسق فيه، إعترف بكل شيئ، وأن ملف الشامبو، موجود بشركة لطيفة، وعندما سطوا على الشركة ليلاً، داهمهم البوليس، وقبض على سيريانوسي، بعد أن هرب الجميع. أصبح المطلوب الآن إثبات براءة دبور وسيريانوسي، وإخراجهم من السجن، ولم ييأس إتش وتغير تماماً، وحلق شعره الكثيف، وحضر مع رفاقه الجدد، حفلاً تنكرياً أقامته الآنسة لطيفة، بمناسبة شراءها ٦٥ % من أسهم شركة دبور، وقاموا بقطع الكهرباء عن الحفل، وإختطاف لطيفة وتهديدها، حتى إعترفت بما فعلت فى شامبو دبور، وحرقها لأوراق تسجيل المستحضر بوزارة الصحة، وشراءها لذمة شعراوي، وكان البوليس كالعادة يختبئ خلف الباب، وسجل إعترافات لطيفة، وقبض عليها، وأفرجت النيابة عن دبور الكبير وسيريانوسي، وتزوج إتش دبووور من أرواح. (إتش دبووور)

programme.title: Rock Paper Scissors / Tas Kagit Makas
programme.desc: In a dramatic context, a cleaner who suffers from Alzheimer's is accused of murder, and his son, who has an uncanny memory, must help him, because he has become his last hope of survival and proving his innocence in the face of a family that has great influence in Istanbul. / في إطار درامي، يتعرض عامل نظافة مريض بالزهايمر لاتهام بالقتل، ويجب على ابنه صاحب الذاكرة الخارقة أن يساعده، لأنه أصبح أمله الأخير في النجاة، وإثبات براءته في مواجهة عائلة لديها نفوذ كبير في إسطنبول.

programme.title: Birth certificate part 2 / شهادة ميلاد ج2
programme.desc: In the second season, Narges discovers that Kulthum and Qasim are not her real parents, and that she was replaced with another child when she was born. programme.title: Whole number +1 / كامل العدد +1

programme.title: Pariersii / Parineetii
programme.desc: The events take place in a dramatic context, as fate leads two close friends to marry the same man, which leads to many difficulties with the emergence of a complex love triangle, and events follow one another. / تدور الأحداث في إطار درامي، حيث يقود القدر صديقتين مقربتين للزواج من نفس الرجل، مما يؤدي إلى العديد من الصعوبات مع ظهور مثلث حب معقد، وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: I love you / Mujhe Pyar Hua Tha
programme.desc: The events take place in a romantic context, where Saad falls in love with his cousin, Maher, and when he fails to confess his love and feelings for her, his life takes a radically different turn. / تدور الأحداث في إطار رومانسي، حيث يقع (سعد) في حب ابنة عمه (ماهير)، وعندما يفشل في الاعتراف لها بحبه ومشاعره تجاهها، تأخذ حياته منعطفًا مختلفًا جذريًا.

programme.title: Floor Vedf / كف ودفوف
programme.desc: A social drama that takes place during the 1980s, in which Salima leads a women's singing group, but is forced to retire after the death of her husband, as hallucinations control her, and she believes that there is a jinn following her and putting her life and the life of her family at stake. / دراما اجتماعية تدور خلال ثمانينيات القرن الماضي، حيث سليمة التي تقود فرقة غنائية نسائية، ولكن تضطر للاعتزال بعد وفاة زوجها، حيث تُسيطر عليها الهلاوس، وتعتقد بوجود جن يتبعها ويجعل حياتها وحياة أسرتها على المحك.

programme.title: Gamma Island / جزيرة غمام
programme.desc: Khaldoun and Al-Ayqa Al-Ghajariya settle on Gammam Island and try to control the people of the island, thinking that it contains a treasure and a big secret that no one knows. They try to extend their influence to implement their plan. Will the people of the island confront them, led by Arafat, Al-Ajmi, and Muhareb? / يستقر خلدون والعايقة الغجرية في جزيرة غمام ويحاولان السيطرة على أهل الجزيرة ظنًا منهم أنها تحوي كنز وسر كبير لا يعلمه أحد ويحاولان بسط نفوذهم لتنفيذ مخططهم، فهل يتصدى أهل الجزيرة لهما بقيادة عرفات والعجمي ومحارب.

programme.title: Home 12 / منزل 12
programme.desc: Munira has an unusual sense that makes her see things from other worlds, so she helps people with that sense, until her young son Saqr dies in a car accident, so her life turns upside down and she decides to stay away from everything, and live a quiet life with her husband Muhammad, but the appearance of her neighbor Nadia in their lives changes the situation to the worst. / تمتلك منيرة حاسة غير عادية تجعلها ترى أشياء من العوالم الأخرى، فتساعد الناس بتلك الحاسة، إلى أن يتوفى ابنها الصغير صقر في حادث سيارة، فتنقلب حياتها رأسا على عقب وتقرر الابتعاد عن كل شيء، وتحيا حياة هادئة مع زوجها محمد، إلا أن ظهور جارتها نادية في حياتهما يبدل الأحوال إلى ما لا يحمد عقباه.

programme.title: earthquake / زلزال
programme.desc: The events of the series revolve around the period of the 1992 earthquake, about Harbi, who buys a house in installments from Khalil. When the time comes to pay the last installment, he demands that he register the house in his name and give up ownership. However, Khalil delays until the 1992 earthquake occurs, in which Harbi dies and the house collapses as a result of the earthquake and its consequences. Khalil then refuses to hand over the plot of land on which the house was built to the heirs. The deceased, which creates a clash between him and Muhammad Ibn Harbi, and despite the latter’s love story with Khalil’s daughter, the girl’s father stands as an obstacle between them. / تدور أحداث مسلسل في فترة زلزال 1992، عن (حربي) الذي يشتري منزلا بالقسط من (خليل) وحين يأتي موعد سداد القسط الأخير، يطالبه بتسجيل البيت باسمه والتنازل عن ملكيته، إلا أن (خليل) يُماطل إلى أن يقع "زلزال 1992" الذي يلقى فيه (حربي) حتفه وينهار المنزل على إثر الزلزال وتبعاته، فيرفض حينها خليل تسليم قطعة الأرض التي كان المنزل يُقام عليها لورثة الراحل، ما يخلق صدامًا بينه وبين محمد ابن حربي، وعلى الرغم من وجود قصة حب تجمع الأخير بابنة خليل، فإن والد الفتاة يقف عائقا بينهما.

programme.title: Gamma Island / جزيرة غمام

programme.title: Profa / بروفا
programme.desc: Majed works as a principal at a private school for his grandmother, Laila, but he sees that he is not doing anything at school, so he seeks change, as well as in his private life because of the problems between him and his wife, Nora, and upon getting to know Layal, who works as a dog trainer and a musician in a restaurant, a number of paradoxes and situations begin between them. / يعمل ماجد مدير مدرسة خاصة عند جدته ليلى، لكنه يرى أنه لا يقوم بشيء في المدرسة فيسعى للتغيير، وكذلك في حياته الخاصة بسبب المشاكل التي بينه وبين زوجته نورا، وبتعرفه على ليال التي تعمل مدربة كلاب وعازفة في مطعم، تبدأ بينهما عدد من المفارقات والمواقف.

programme.title: Profa / بروفا
programme.desc: Majed works as a principal at a private school for his grandmother, Laila, but he sees that he is not doing anything at school, so he seeks change, as well as in his private life because of the problems between him and his wife, Nora, and upon getting to know Layal, who works as a dog trainer and a musician in a restaurant, a number of paradoxes and situations begin between them. / يعمل ماجد مدير مدرسة خاصة عند جدته ليلى، لكنه يرى أنه لا يقوم بشيء في المدرسة فيسعى للتغيير، وكذلك في حياته الخاصة بسبب المشاكل التي بينه وبين زوجته نورا، وبتعرفه على ليال التي تعمل مدربة كلاب وعازفة في مطعم، تبدأ بينهما عدد من المفارقات والمواقف.

programme.title: Home 12 / منزل 12
programme.desc: Munira has an unusual sense that makes her see things from other worlds, so she helps people with that sense, until her young son Saqr dies in a car accident, so her life turns upside down and she decides to stay away from everything, and live a quiet life with her husband Muhammad, but the appearance of her neighbor Nadia in their lives changes the situation to the worst. / تمتلك منيرة حاسة غير عادية تجعلها ترى أشياء من العوالم الأخرى، فتساعد الناس بتلك الحاسة، إلى أن يتوفى ابنها الصغير صقر في حادث سيارة، فتنقلب حياتها رأسا على عقب وتقرر الابتعاد عن كل شيء، وتحيا حياة هادئة مع زوجها محمد، إلا أن ظهور جارتها نادية في حياتهما يبدل الأحوال إلى ما لا يحمد عقباه.

programme.title: Pariersii / Parineetii
programme.desc: The events take place in a dramatic context, as fate leads two close friends to marry the same man, which leads to many difficulties with the emergence of a complex love triangle, and events follow one another. / تدور الأحداث في إطار درامي، حيث يقود القدر صديقتين مقربتين للزواج من نفس الرجل، مما يؤدي إلى العديد من الصعوبات مع ظهور مثلث حب معقد، وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: Wild Bees / Wild Bees
programme.desc: In a context of crime and drama, after the death of their father, his three daughters must confront the richest man in their village who wants to buy their fields by force and by offering several temptations. / في إطار من الجريمة والدراما، وبعد وفاة والدهن، يتعين على بناته الثلاث مواجهة أغنى رجل في قريتهم الذي يريد شراء حقولهم بالقوة ومن خلال تقديم عدة مغريات.

programme.title: Floor Vedf / كف ودفوف
programme.desc: A social drama that takes place during the 1980s, in which Salima leads a women's singing group, but is forced to retire after the death of her husband, as hallucinations control her, and she believes that there is a jinn following her and putting her life and the life of her family at stake. / دراما اجتماعية تدور خلال ثمانينيات القرن الماضي، حيث سليمة التي تقود فرقة غنائية نسائية، ولكن تضطر للاعتزال بعد وفاة زوجها، حيث تُسيطر عليها الهلاوس، وتعتقد بوجود جن يتبعها ويجعل حياتها وحياة أسرتها على المحك.

programme.title: Gamma Island / جزيرة غمام
programme.desc: Khaldoun and Al-Ayqa Al-Ghajariya settle on Gammam Island and try to control the people of the island, thinking that it contains a treasure and a big secret that no one knows. They try to extend their influence to implement their plan. Will the people of the island confront them, led by Arafat, Al-Ajmi, and Muhareb? / يستقر خلدون والعايقة الغجرية في جزيرة غمام ويحاولان السيطرة على أهل الجزيرة ظنًا منهم أنها تحوي كنز وسر كبير لا يعلمه أحد ويحاولان بسط نفوذهم لتنفيذ مخططهم، فهل يتصدى أهل الجزيرة لهما بقيادة عرفات والعجمي ومحارب.
